row.detailed_description: About： It is an old school game collection with ten different types of mini-games. The story tells of a series of wars that took place on the island Feature： Starry Moon Island Out Of Control ：It is a horizontal scroll shooting game Starry Moon Island Red Snake ：It is a Top-Down shooting game Starry Moon Island Star Ocean： It is a Top-Down shooting game in Space Starry Moon Island Break Out： It is a Top-Down shooting use Aim game Starry Moon Island Perimeter： It is a horizontal scroll shooting game in Space
row.short_description: About：It is an old school game collection with ten different types of mini-games.The story tells of a series of wars that took place on the island

row.name: Jaksaljabi
row.detailed_description: Synopsis The academy that is in the central city of the human world 'Pumeungoljjagi', 'Seumugaldae'. A boy who lives in this place 'Neosaegaram' is the one who succeed the name of the 'Jaksaljabi', the symbol of the hero, which is manifested for the first time in centuries. But with this remarkable background, in reality, Neosaegaram was just a grey boy who has no power nor emotion. In this meaningless daily routine, one day a boy contacts with a girl. The girl's name is 'Sonagyurae'. She is one of the people of the 'Git gajin i' that is the enemy of the humanity, and she was living in the heaven once, but fell from the sky. Description Jaksaljabi is a kinetic novel that you can experience unique set-up and story. Feel it with simple controls.
row.short_description: Jaksaljabi is a kinetic novel that you can experience unique set-up and story.

row.name: Evolution: Moon Warfare
row.detailed_description: On a hidden moon base, a war rages on. Two factions fighting for control of the deadly Hilux bio-weapons. Choose a side and fight! Fast paced, low gravity, online sci-fi FPS team deathmatch gameplay set in the Evolution universe containing one level in a moon setting. This is an early access game that we hope to add more levels/modes and refinements over time. Feel free to join the discord to give feedback, let us know what you would like to see added/refined over time.
row.short_description: Low gravity sci-fi FPS team deathmatch game.

row.name: The Tipping Point
row.detailed_description: THE ICE IS COLLAPSING! You play as Cass , an arctic climate researcher. You must get off the ice sheet before it collapses. On your way, you will gather and analyze data about the ice. Make your way over the collapsing ice sheet by jumping, sliding, and climbing. Reach abandoned research stations and gather data in a series of mini-games. Analyze the data and uncover what is happening to the climate. INVESTIGATE AND LEARN The Tipping Point is a 3D side-scroller developed in collaboration with real world researchers in an interdisciplinary effort (physicists, biologists, chemists, statisticians, and more). The things you do in The Tipping Point are based on what researchers do in the arctic in real life. As researchers do, you will compare the data you collect to previous data sets and investigate changes in the climate. UNCOVER WHAT IS HAPPENING TO THE ICE Solve the mystery of the tipping point and why the ice sheet is suddenly collapsing. THANKS TO Funded by EU Horizon 2020 , The Novo Nordisk Foundation , and NordForsk , The Tipping Point is and will forever be available for free. The research groups that contributed to the development of The Tipping Point are: TiPES is a large scientific collaboration with the aim to enhance the understanding of tipping points in the earth system. 18 partner institutions work together in more than 10 countries. The project is funded by EU Horizon 2020. Narwhal NordForsk project, consisting of Aarhus University, Chalmers University, Greenland Institute of Natural Resources, and more. The project is funded by NordForsk. INFO The game is free, without any in-app-purchases. Gameplay time is about 2 hours. Best enjoyed with a controller! DISCLAIMER The exact numbers in the game are not based on real findings. Only the scientific concepts behind the educational content are based on real research. The game takes liberty to dramatisize the covered science. We emplore you to think critically about the conveyed information and educate yourself via other sources. You can find correct information via the links above to the collaborating scientific organisations and institutions.
row.short_description: Developed in collaboration with researchers, The Tipping Point is a fun and educational game about climate science. You play as an arctic climate researcher and must get off the ice sheet before it collapses. On your way, you will gather and analyze data about the ice sheet, before it is lost.

row.name: Netherspace
row.detailed_description: Netherspace is a retro shoot'em'up game that allows the player to travel through 100 levels of increasingly dangerous enemies. 20 merciless giant bosses will challenge the heroes and must be defeated in order for them to reach the conclusion of their difficult journey. Powerful weapons are available since the very beginning with more and more of them becoming available as the story progresses. 'Netherprime' can be collected from opponents defeated to enhance the various aspects of the prototype 'Netherpiercer' spaceship, allowing for greatly varied upgrades experimentation after every single boss vanquished. Netherspace features random enemy swarm formation making every single playthrough different than the last one.
row.short_description: A sci-fi shoot'em'up game with heavy focus on upgrades experimentation, featuring two unlikely heroes that must work perfectly together, despite their share of secrets, to surpass their limits and succeed in eliminating a threat that might destroy both Earth and Andraxia if left unchecked.

row.name: Chill Corner
row.detailed_description: Please wishlist to get news in the future! Love Chill Corner and want to show your support for Chill Town? Join our newsletter today, and stay in the loop with all the latest updates—never miss a beat again! This is just an idle game for chillout and relaxing. Features: Beautiful rooms with chilling atmosphere and weather Many lo-fi, acoustic and other genre of music for chilling, relaxing or focusing Customizing your character and pets Taking a rest by do several in game quest Decorating your room Creating and manage your task Creating and customize your favorite playlist
row.short_description: This is just an idle game for chilling, relaxing or focusing.

row.name: 二狗子历险记
row.detailed_description: 游戏描述：恩，一句话，这是一个比较简单的RM类游戏，剧情很少，基本上都是为了推进游戏进度的一些简单剧情，就是那种，去哪，杀谁，掉什么的那种！！ 游戏的整体思路就是刷刷怪，打打装备，玩家不是在刷装备，就是在刷装备的路上！ 我呢比较爱玩游戏，从F C到MD，到PS到PC，从单机到网络。现在人到中年，突然发现，玩不动游戏了，那些需要微操，需要反应的游戏玩不了了，那些需要组团需要熬夜的游戏也玩不了了。慢慢的，就只能玩玩一些简单的复古类单机独立游戏！！ 这游戏呢，玩着玩着，总有些设定是不合自己意愿的，也就萌生了自己做一个游戏玩玩的想法。 20年的11月开始接触r m v的软件 ，没有编程基础，也只能用这种比较简单直白的软件了，中间做做停停，到现在也算是做的差不多了。 游戏的整体时间预计是40个小时，分成4个部分，剧情就不讲了。 玩法呢，就是刷刷装备，装备随机性比较大，技能呢也没什么限制，有什么就用什么。 考虑到有些玩家可能没什么时间一直刷装备，就内置了一个挂机功能，设置下挂机次数就可以了，有空了就去看看有什么收获，不过战斗AI比较低，别指望去挂BOSS。 当然，属性碾压的话，还是可以考虑挂BOSS的。 BOSS的设置，稍有有点难度，有几个BOSS还是需要玩家去研究下机制的，不过整体难度也不大，等级提升的属性比较可观，实在打不过就练级嘛！！ 所有的怪都有隐藏掉落，有兴趣的玩家可以多多尝试，有些掉落还是比较值得刷的。当然，所有的BOSS都是可以反复的攻略的，属性碾压的也可以考虑直接挂机BOSS。 游戏里的大部分装备都可以用材料来合成，考虑到有的玩家自带不掉落光环，合成也是一个比较重要的装备获取方式。 课代表总结：一款刷刷游戏，可以挂机，可以合成，嗯，没了！ 最后，希望大家注意时间，2小时内是可以退款的，如果您不喜欢这个游戏的话，请注意时间，及早退款！！ 最后，希望大家注意时间，2小时内是可以退款的，如果您不喜欢这个游戏的话，请注意时间，及早退款！！ 最后，希望大家注意时间，2小时内是可以退款的，如果您不喜欢这个游戏的话，请注意时间，及早退款！！ 重要的事情说三遍。 游戏交流群是：747792523 二狗子历险记交流群 有兴趣的玩家可以加群！！！
row.short_description: 一款休闲娱乐的R P G游戏，游戏时间在30-50小时，没有无脑的BOSS战斗，都要稍微动点脑才能过关。 合理搭配队伍技能和词缀是你通关的关键所在。

row.name: my MusicOasis
row.detailed_description: This Steam Early Access game is currently not a finished game and may or may not change significantly over the course of development. To learn more about Steam Early Access, please visit Overview As a musician or DJ while playing this game you will learn about different types of Music Genres, DMX DJ Lighting, Music Production Techniques and how to put on killer shows online featuring your music. You can collaborate with others as you customize from one of over 20 'starter clubs'. You can hold events and light shows that you can your Steam Friends tp along with your growing set of fans you meet playing myMO. myMO has many camera and recording tools to help you shoot Machinima music videos of your music sets and songs inside your customized club/venue. For the fan of music, this is a great way to make the scene by customizing your avatar and attending dance events, play beat games at the dances, create new dance moves and explore various music genres. It is easy to socialize at these events with both Voice and Text Chat in the game. For a promoter, you can customize one of the many venues and build your own club and invite DJ and Musicians to play events inside your club. Establish a virtual label with a stable of musicians you meet. Build your virtual music empire. In the games edit mode, if you are a creative 3d modeler, you can add your own models and graphics to the customized clubs to show off your work. Key Features Easily Customize the Venues to your vision of the perfect place to Rave. Stream in live or recorded music via Twitch or YouTube. Pipe in Desktop Audio from your DAW or DJ application. Customize your Avatar to best represent your brand. Learn the ins and outs of DMX DJ Lighting used in real life Light Shows. Explore Amazing Visual Effects that react to the Music Beats and Frequencies. Make friends with other Musicians, Fans and Ravers. Learn about various Genres and what is behind the music.
row.short_description: myMO (my Music Oasis) is an immersive multiplayer game built for a community of DJs, Musicians, and Music Fans to share beats while raving in a virtual world that features player customizable Dance Clubs, DJ Controlled Lights & Awesome Visual Effects.

row.name: Bridge of Dawn
row.detailed_description: Bridge of Dawn is a free, open-sourced 3D arcade/racing style game for one or two players. Follow the story of Vulpes the Fox as he rushes to catch the sun and find out the secret to everlasting life. Bridge of Dawn was created by Kimberly Blais, founder of Mama Makes Games, during a week-long Epic MegaJam. Set in the magical world of the Isle of Mist, Bridge of Dawn is a lighthearted and fun game for all ages. Featuring original music by Australian hip-hop star YNG Matryr, rising artist YNG SiLICON, and Madame X! Exciting arcade-style gameplay featuring one- and two-player support Easy-to-learn, hard-to-master action that challenges you to get the best score and time A fun fairytale-like story drawn from the fantasy world of the Isle of Mist Animated cutscenes with voice-acting by professional voice actor Erica Schroeder Race side-by-side or play 'Fox Tag' in local multiplayer Huge island racing map filled with plants, roads, rocks, and 'Timekeeper' opponents Dynamic music that adapts to your progress and performance NVidia Real-Time Ray Tracing (RTRT) support Available in English , Spanish , and Chinese , with full translation of subtitles and user interface Completely free and open-source to download, play, and modify however you'd like How to Play Goal: Reach the waypoints before the timer runs out. The higher you are when you touch the waypoint, the more points you get. Move: Use the mouse and WASD keys or a controller to move the fox. For two-player mode, the keyboard moves the first fox and the controller moves the second fox. Jump and Sprint: To jump, press Spacebar or the A/Y button on the controller. The longer you hold jump, the higher you'll jump when you release it. To sprint, hold Shift or the B/X button on the controller. Fox Tag : In Fox Tag mode, players take turn being 'it' and trying to tag the other player. Open-Sourced Fun Bridge of Dawn is fully open-sourced under the highly permissive MIT license! You can download the project to learn how the game was created, make any changes you'd like, and then release your own version of the game. Just install Unreal Engine 4, download the Bridge of Dawn source code, and open the 'BridgeOfDawn_UEProj.uproject' file.
row.short_description: Bridge of Dawn is a free, open-sourced 3D arcade/racing style game for one or two players. Follow the story of Vulpes the Fox as he rushes to catch the sun and find out the secret to everlasting life in this lighthearted and fun game for all ages.

row.name: GunsBox VR
row.detailed_description: Have you ever shot a revolver? Now grab one, feel its coldness and weight, install a scope, and make a goddamn perfect shot. Learn how to use and customize different types of guns. Create your own levels and share them with the community. We've created this sandbox for you inspired by the popular VR titles. Playing this game, you will find out more about various guns, their features, and their design. You will get experience in shooting with optic and collimator scopes as well as using special grips and handguards. Your home location includes your personal shooting range. With “Remote Controller”, a special level-editing tool, you can create your own training configuration and level up your skill. For the first game mode, we've created IPSC based competition. You can compete across the globe in IPSC tournaments or create stages and share them with the community. More game modes and mechanics will be added soon. Stay tuned! Key Features: Realistic weapon physics - single and two-handed operation, center of mass (depends on installed accessories), weight, inertia Most frequently used weapon mechanics - semi-automatic, single action, double action, bolt action, pump action, revolvers Weapon accessories and tuning - scopes and sights (optic and collimator), handguards, grips, tactical flashlight, recoil compensators Weapons safety, feeding, and firing features - realistic and accurate implementation VR hands and custom gloves - all interactions have correct hand animations and pose selection Level editor - create your own levels, setup props interactions, share with the community and compete Tournaments and matches with global leaderboards under IPSC rules Designed for all popular VR headsets and controllers Smooth locomotion, snap turns and teleportation supported
row.short_description: Have you ever shot a revolver? Now grab one, feel its coldness and weight, install a scope, and make a goddamn perfect shot. Learn how to use and customize different types of guns. Create levels and share them with the community. We've created this sandbox inspired by the popular VR titles for you.

row.name: Ibatic
row.detailed_description: In Ibatic you can slide, wall run, wall jump and use your powers to create staffs that will allow you to jump great distances. By mastering these abilities you will be able to go through the levels at full speed with a feeling of total control. You will discover several mechanics in various levels ranging from doors, bombs to tornadoes. Are you ready to speedrun through the planet Ibatic ?
row.short_description: Ibatic is a fast-paced platformer in which you evolve in a fantastic world. Beat the fastest time in each level by sliding, jumping and dashing through various deadly environments using the power of your staff.

row.name: The Savior From Above
row.detailed_description: The Savior From Above is a sidescrolling 3D adventure shortgame that combines multiple genres and features various action and puzzle sequences. Its artistic approach is supported by powerful visuals, intense atmosphere and a unique game narrative on the boundaries of science-fiction and fantasy. An unnamed astronaut crashes his space capsule on an alien planet. As he explores the strange surroundings, he soon discovers that his arrival may not have been entirely accidental. According to the remains of an ancient local culture, he is believed to play a significant role in their history. The Savior From Above is a one-man project, a bitesize piece of handcrafted game art, the first release from its creator. The game is 100% free, but any financial support is highly appreciated. Please see the DLCs for donation options. Thank you and safe journeys!
row.short_description: A sidescrolling 3D adventure shortgame that combines multiple genres and features various action and puzzle sequences. Its artistic approach is supported by powerful visuals, intense atmosphere and a unique game narrative on the boundaries of science-fiction and fantasy.

row.name: Friends of little Yus
row.detailed_description: Friends of Little Yus is a speedrunning game, challenge your friends to get to the flag as fast as possible. But be aware, there are obstacles which would like to have a word with you. Find the quickest path and get yourself into the top 10. This singleplayer game is currently in alpha state, we will keep on developing and have big plans to add multiplayer support in the future. The current version of the game has a tournament system, every 14 days a new round will start with a random map. Each map has a different path, style and obstacles to keep the game interesting and fun. Every new round the leaderboard will be reset. Players can view scores using the built-in leaderboard system making it easy to track players and find about the times to beat (or hold).
row.short_description: Friends of little Yus is a speedrunning game, race to the flag as fast as possible to reach the top. New rounds start every 14 days resetting the leaderboard meaning fresh chances for everyone!

row.name: thEiAoLoGy
row.detailed_description: An Atomic Game-Engine Generate Voxel realms using FATE Share FATEs with your friends with links that work in browsers and in game Explore curated realms from the DEMOs and Over World. Each Voxel is an Atom of a system of 256 x 256 ! Procedural generation tools for quick variation and iteration. Plot atoms using variance and flocking patterns like birds. City Physics - Explore a rainy city block with physics on the rain run off. Over World - 8 realms clustered around the center pillar. Aero - Bullet Hell where the bullets are alive. Star Voyage - Cheesy 90s Intro Space Drama Opener. Use the Weave or LISP editors bidirectionally. a Timeline that orchestrates events across a song's duration .vox support for plotting complex voxels Drag and Drop assets onto the browser to mix in Download any part of a FATE file as its original form (VOX/LISP/MP3)
row.short_description: An Atomic Game Engine that weaves FATE. Generative Voxel VR Realms Await.

row.name: Сollision Hero
row.detailed_description: The typical hero travels to typical locations, killing typical enemies with typical weapons. Kawaii ? Sure, UwU. Take a part in the most ordinary adventure. Become the most ordinary hero: Discover the Most Common Levels Overcome the Most Common Obstacles Use the most common store to buy the most common equipment Fight against the most common monsters : Goblins Skeletons Slugs Boxes (really?)
row.short_description: The typical hero travels to typical locations, killing typical enemies with typical weapons. Kawaii ? Sure, UwU.

row.name: Box Survivors World in Deathrun Guys
row.detailed_description: Deathrun Guys - Bunnyhop is an endless platform running game with the goal of getting the highest score and getting into the top players list. This game features a Bunnyhop mechanic to gain more speed while jumping. - Bunnyhop / bhop mechanics - Characterization of characters - Multiplayer ranking Get Deathrun Guys - Bunnyhop now and enjoy!
row.short_description: Deathrun Guys - Bunnyhop is an endless platform running game with the goal of getting the highest score and getting into the top players list. This game features a Bunnyhop mechanic to gain more speed while jumping.

row.name: CYBERDAD
row.detailed_description: Set in the year 2078, CYBERDAD is a 2D cyberpunk gunfight dungeon crawler following a disgruntled father seeking to rescue his daughter, and exact his revenge. You are a former employee of The Company, they have kidnapped your daughter, baiting your return. As you fight through floors of robots to rescue her, you will discover many things about The Company, and uncover the dark, sinister truth that they've been hiding for far too long. Slay different types of Roids, find and equip different types of weapons, and wreak havoc on The Company. Explore and Clear Floors - Four unique levels, complete with different enemies and challenges to overcome! Slay Robots - Fight through hordes of four different Roid types, all with unique abilities and weaknesses! Discover New Equipment and Weapons - Find and equip four different weapon types. Each has its own strength and weakness! Uncover Lore Documents - Piece together the story, and the truth behind the happenings at The Company, through old emails, files, and chat logs. Rescue Your Daughter - Fight to reach the deepest floor of The Company's facility, where the daughter can be found. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Set in the year 2078, CYBERDAD is a 2D cyberpunk gunfight dungeon crawler following a disgruntled father seeking to rescue his daughter, and exact his revenge.

row.name: DKLS
row.detailed_description: You wake up. It's 6:00 a.m. You find yourself in what seems to be the room of a video games freak. There is no one else and there is no way out of the room. The only thing you remember is four letters: DKLS DKLS is a game that will make you reconsider the way of understanding video games. With a strong experimental and metaphysical sense, DKLS invites you to question the existing reality in a video game. In DKLS you can be a person, but you can also be a car, a cactus, a microbe, a penguin or even a pencil. After playing for a few minutes on the DKLS machines, you will stop feeling your gamer physical reality and begin to feel the virtual reality of DKLS. Feel the experience of dissociating from your own reality. Discover DKLS and all that it offers to you.
row.short_description: In DKLS you can be a person, but you can also be a car, a cactus, a microbe, a penguin or even a pencil. Feel the experience of dissociating from your own reality.

row.name: Rogue Planet 1
row.detailed_description: DISCLAIMER: STEAM VERSION OF THE GAME MAY BE PRONE TO TECHNICAL ISSUES AND/OR MAY NOT WORK CORRECTLY. PLEASE REFER TO THE NEWS FOR NEWER VERSIONS OF THE GAME AND THE STEAM GUIDES FOR FIXES. THANK YOU FOR PLAYING. Rogue Planet is a short horror game about the Mayan Phenomenon of 2012. Made over the course of 3 years as my first big Steam game using GameGuru. STORY MODE: You are Markus Steelwyre: a soldier trapped in an endless cycle of misery in the Mayan Year of 2012. You are comatose after being seemingly shot in both arms, and the face. Yet you miraculously survive and find yourself in the events leading to that moment. The world is slowly ending, and you can't escape it. This is no dream. It's a nightmare! If you wish to survive, you must burn the memories to the ground if the real world is to continue, since a world without consequences can't exist and be happy, right? As you continue, the horrible truths of the dream become reality. The longer you stay, the more real they become. How can you know where you're going if you can't remember where you came from? And how far will you walk away from reality before you see where it leads? Wait where is everyone? Are you having deja vu or are you going in circles? And is she begging for you to end the world? Only you know what you're willing to sacrifice. The clock is ticking. Your destiny is nigh. FEATURES: 2-3 hour long story. 26 Levels. 10 Weapons. (4 Hidden Ones.) Colorful CRT-Style visuals. Music by the talented folks who volunteered their time and help. Various locations of a fantastical and war torn Santa Fe, New Mexico in multiple states of reality to explore. WARNING: This game may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy or those sensitive to bright and flashing lights. Play at your own risk.
row.short_description: Rogue Planet is a short action horror FPS game based on the Mayan Phenomenon of 2012. Made over the course of 3 years as my first game using GameGuru. A personal passion project.
row.notes: Flashing and bright lights, surreal and psychedelic visuals, frequent firefights and violent action, strong language, and blood and gore.

row.name: 战棋三国-英雄(Three Kingdoms : Hero) Playtest
Visite virtuelle de l'Assemblée nationale
row.detailed_description: Visit the French National Assembly from home! Freely explore the National Assembly and the Hôtel de Lassay using your computer, Steam Deck, or virtual reality headset, in a fully immersive experience. A place of exceptional heritage and history Wander at your own pace through the iconic spaces of the National Assembly — the chamber, the library, the reception rooms, and the gardens — with smooth and intuitive navigation. Discover areas rarely open to the public, such as the Hôtel de Lassay, the official residence of the President of the National Assembly. An interactive tour Interact with artworks, paintings, and statues to access detailed information about each piece. Follow the guided tour in the chamber, or explore freely to learn more about the symbols, institutions, and heritage of the French Republic. A shared experience with friends Thanks to multiplayer mode, visit the National Assembly and the Hôtel de Lassay together, online or via local network. Enjoy a collective journey with friends or in a group.

row.detailed_description: 我们希望能在《大城主攻略版》中与玩家共同体验新内容，并与各位玩家进行有效的交流，从而优化提升游戏内容。我们诚邀各位玩家体验，并向我们提出宝贵的意见与建议！（安装中遇到任何问题或者启动游戏出现BUG，欢迎大家加群进行反馈，我们会在第一时间为您解决问题。官方QQ群：715328969） *官方QQ群：715328969！！进群赠送神秘礼包一份！！ 《大城主攻略版》是一款拥有沉浸式体验感以三国时代为背景的战争策略类游戏，新颖的系统玩法，一路过关斩将，不断壮大自己的武将队伍，运用灵活多变的策略战术通关每一个关卡，还有过关斩将的爬塔玩法，让玩家感到每日都有变强的直观体验，更可以通过挑战三国名将来获取强大武将。丰富的国战活动，原创章节剧情，完全让玩家感到仿佛进入一个热血澎湃的三国时代。 【游戏特色】 1、三国名将，争霸天下 上百武将汇聚，万千铁骑待命，举世无双的武将技能，威风凛凛的坐骑呈现史诗级战场！更有特色系统玩法——《名将挑战》通过挑战三国名将，将强大的武将纳入麾下！ 2、运筹帷幄，策略至上 玩家不仅需要收集武将征战天下，同时对于排兵布阵，武将属性策略都要熟悉，甚至以弱胜强，战力并不是唯一取胜的标准。 3、群雄逐鹿，攻城略地 业内独创大国战玩法：玩家开创自己的国家，通过科技，征兵，战争，跑商等等建设国家。发展势力，招募名将，开启万人国战，远攻近交，攻陷城池，与您共赴荣誉，三国霸业，指日可待！ 4、跨服竞技，决胜千里 激战全面升级，不仅同服竞技，还可进行跨服激战，血脉贲张，决胜千里，一起步入荣誉的殿堂！ 5、神兵利器，谁与争锋 兵马未动武器先行，全新的武器装备强化、突破系统，让玩家打造属于自己的神兵利器！ 6、精湛制作，高端品质 沉淀多年用心打磨，力保最大程度还原史诗级三国战场，国风人物原画设计，山川湖泊场景搭配，沉浸感十足！

row.name: Impulse
row.detailed_description: Picture a mash-up of Super Meat Boy and Lunar Lander. Or N+ meets Asteroids. That’s Impulse. The premise is simple. You need to guide your craft to the exit point of each level, avoiding the various obstacles and bad guys. Levels are short, sometimes brutal affairs. There are no life limits, retry as many times as you need. Restarting a level is instant. There’s no waiting or loading — one moment you’re dead, a click of the mouse later and you’re ready to try again. You can even suicide so you don’t have to wait for death when you know you’ve fouled up. Your craft is at the whim of Newtonian physics. With only a simple thruster you need to battle the forces of gravity and atmospheric drag all while avoiding high-speed impact. The trouble is that all these variables are liable to change with each level. Gravity could be strong, or weak, or zero; it may pull in any direction. Drag might mirror the vacuum of space or the ocean depths. Your craft’s thrusters might be strong or weak. You might have limited or limitless fuel. Your hull might laugh off high-speed impacts or it might shatter from the slightest bump. With all these variables, levels take on very different feels. Some require careful thinking and gentle, deliberate action. Others are all about reflexes and reaction. Most are a mixture of both.
row.short_description: Picture a mash-up of Super Meat Boy and Lunar Lander. Or N+ meets Asteroids. That’s Impulse.
row.reviews: “Impulse may be a tough nut to crack, but it's brilliantly designed and never gets frustrating. Besides, you'll never tire of dying. This is a game of a thousand deaths that keeps transforming itself.” Rock Paper Shotgun “It's a game that will make you shout 'balls to the universe' several times over.” Nerd³ “The game then itself becomes a grander tutorial, really, because you’re constantly learning and that’s a real compliment to a game that’s so minimal.” Video Attack!

row.name: The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle
row.detailed_description: WHICH EDITION IS RIGHT FOR ME? WHICH EDITION IS RIGHT FOR ME? Depending on your history with ESO, there are two basic versions of High Isle that you first need to consider: The Collection—Includes the base game, the 2022 High Isle Chapter and ALL previous Chapters (Morrowind, Summerset, Elsweyr, Greymoor, and Blackwood) The Upgrade—Includes the 2022 High Isle Chapter exclusively The Collection is perfect if you’re a new player looking to take your first steps into Tamriel, while the Upgrade is ideal for existing players who already own the base game and some (or all!) of the previous Chapters. Even better, the Collection grants new players access to the base game and previous Chapters! Of course, even if you’re an existing player, the Collection with all the previous Chapters might be a great deal for you. Collector's Edition Purchase The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: High Isle Collector's Edition to receive these bonus Collector’s Edition items: • Amenos Ornaug • Balfiera Senche Cub • Ascendant Knight Outfit Style • Hoard of the Schemers Memento • High Isle Emote Pack • And Previous Collector’s Edition Rewards! About the Game The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: High Isle is the ultimate Elder Scrolls experience and includes the Base Game and all Chapters: High Isle (New for 2022) Blackwood Greymoor Elsweyr Summerset Morrowind INCLUDES LATEST CHAPTER: HIGH ISLE —Set out on ESO's year-long adventure, the Legacy of the Bretons, and uncover an epic storytelling experience told across three DLCs and the High Isle Chapter. A tale of chivalric honor and political upheaval set within the stunning Systres Archipelago awaits. ULTIMATE FREEDOM —Create your ultimate RPG character, play solo or adventure with friends, and determine your fate in an ever-expanding world. With no level restrictions, go anywhere at any time in a truly open world. In The Elder Scrolls Online, the choice is yours. CHOOSE YOUR ADVENTURE —Begin your adventure where you like: emerge from Coldharbour in the Base Game, battle Dragons in the Elsweyr Chapter, or face the Prince of Destruction, Mehrunes Dagon, in Blackwood. All content is accessible for new players, and you can switch adventures whenever you like.

row.detailed_description: The Giraffe World is a cute puzzler where you play as Mimolette the Giraffe who can extend her neck indefinitely ! Go through multiple worlds each with it's unique mood and solve puzzles and mazes to retrieve your favorite hats ! row.name: Everlife
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Everlife Classic Everlife is a fast-paced maze game where you must survive a mysterious realm that you have fallen into.  This version of the game is the original version, and it contains chapters 1 and 2. Collect the star and get out You are tasked with collecting stars from a variety of worlds, and returning safely. There are three different dimensions available, do you have what it takes to survive? Get running You are never safe in the dimensions. Dash at high speeds to the star, or to safety. Outmaneuver the monsters and make split second decisions to stay in one piece! Use abilities You are equipped with a special weapon. With it, you are granted special abilities. Use them to defend, deter, and escape danger. You'll start with only one ability, but you'll gain a new ability at the start of every level! row.short_description: Everlife is a fast-paced maze game where you use mystical abilities to collect stars from several unique environments and escape them without being killed.

row.short_description: CyberWhiskey: Guy's Room is a walk and click adventure game set in 2053. You've got twenty minutes to get ready for work while solving puzzles and talking to a sarcastic robot.

row.name: 英雄黄昏-文字三国志&曹贼模拟器
row.detailed_description: —————————————————游戏历程————————————————— 我是隐隐狗，是个三国迷。我从小喜欢三国和中国古代历史，玩遍三国类游戏。 2012年大学毕业，面对职场困扰，我萌生一个念头：做一款好玩的三国游戏！ 于是学土木的我从工地离职，跑遍南北，几经周转，终于转行做了游戏策划。 在游戏行业摸爬滚打好几年，经历了各种商业项目，曾经的梦想始终萦绕于心。 直到2017年，我决定有所行动，开始用业余时间自学Unity3D游戏引擎。 每天下班回来坚持学了3个月，然后开始自己摸索着做游戏，躺过无数的坑。 2018年初，经过了一个练手的项目后（DLC中的玩法），我开始做这个游戏。 从此以后，我的生活只有做三国游戏、吃饭睡觉和上班，如此持续到现在。 2021年9月，我在Steam上发布游戏，刚开始体验比较差的，收到很多反馈。 主要是自己闭门造车，缺乏对游戏性和体验的良好把握，很多设定不甚合理。 于是我不停自己体验，热心接纳大家意见，不断修改和优化游戏，坚持更新。 如果在游戏过程中遇到不舒服的体验，欢迎联系我来反馈，我会积极改进。 我会以此为毕生使命一直更新下去，即便游戏只剩下我一个玩家也不会放弃。 不过因为我是半路自学，在做的时候留下不少坑，导致很多想做的较难实现， 比如地图扩展、开放MOD等，我也很想玩到这些，但需要点时间来攻克难题。 我本以为没人会玩这样的游戏，感谢每一位体验过这款游戏的玩家，真心感谢！ —————————————————交流途径————————————————— ▶ 作者QQ：1025966822 ▶ 交流QQ群：607451655 在QQ群里也可以找到作者，还有精通游戏的大神，以及游戏资料、高级存档。 如果需要手机包，也可以加以上QQ群，在群文件里下载安装，仅限安卓手机。 —————————————————友情提醒————————————————— ▶ 如果对游戏画面有要求，这款游戏可以忽略，它确实没有任何精致的画面。 ▶ 游戏只在Steam平台更新，作者未在其他平台发布或更新游戏。 ▶ 游戏暂不支持【4k显示设备】、【Mac设备】。 ▶ 如果遇到任何不好的体验，或有游戏的建议、想法，欢迎联系作者。
row.short_description: 这是三国玩家的童话世界，新奇而独特，虽然其貌不扬，但内在很丰富。在游戏里扮演着类似穿越者的角色，在三国世界可以自由地实现各种幻想，甚至可以体验当曹贼的乐趣，另外还可以挂机摸鱼。它的缺点除了没有画面和上手较难，还没有团队，只有业余的作者一人，因热爱而坚持，若有反馈可以联系作者。

row.name: ELE RAMPAGE
row.detailed_description: Play as an elephant on a rampage! The objective is simple, destroy killer robots to score points Features high-paced action as more and more robots spawn with deadly intent. You can now play as both Ele the Elephant who uses a water blast to destroy her enemies and Wooly the Mammoth who prefers to take things up close and personal, each character has their own unique style. Players can also compete to find out who is the best using the online leaderboards.
row.short_description: Destroy robots and send humans flying by ramming into them as a big angry elephant, or a giant mammoth and cause as much chaos as possible. The objective is simple but it won't be easy. Features fast paced action.

row.name: Moon Runner
row.detailed_description: Use your abilities to find lost modules and trade them for equipment, then traverse the lunar landscape while dealing with enemies corrupted by something beneath the surface... Features: Survival, traversal and action gameplay. A moody and atmospheric lunar setting. A spherical level with a map and inventory system. Delivery missions to earn extra credits for upgrades and equipment. A global leaderboard entry of your final score, based on completed objectives and gameplay stats.
row.short_description: You are tasked with urgent maintenance on a small moon. Find the monoliths and manage your survival to complete your mysterious assignment.

row.name: Anti Frank's Wrath
row.detailed_description: Anti Frank is unleashing his wrath on the universe! Play by yourself or with a few friends locally to take down hoards of zombies and stop Anti Frank! Play as one of four unique characters and buy new upgrades and weapons as you rid the universe of zombies. Anti Frank's Wrath is a top-down arcade shoot-em up based in the futuristic 1980's. It supports 4 player local co-op (or steam remote play).
row.short_description: Anti Frank is unleashing his wrath on the universe! Play by yourself or with a few friends locally to take down hoards of zombies and stop Anti Frank! Play as one of four unique characters and buy new upgrades and weapons as you rid the universe of zombies.

row.name: The Sink Gods
row.detailed_description: What is the Sink Gods? The Sink Gods is a modern point-n-click adventure where you play a poor villager who lives in the Sink Valley. After you are evicted from your home, you must travel to the temples of The Sink Gods and complete their challenges to regain what you have lost... Art and Aesthetic The Sink Gods has a hand drawn cartoon art style, with frame by frame animation. The game uses vector graphics to reach an infinite resolution, so the game will look crystal clear on all devices. UI The Sink Gods utilises a simple and clean UI design that is easy to read. Use left, right, and down arrows on the edges of the screen to move around the various temples. Use the inventory on the right of the screen to inspect and use items you find! Gameplay And Puzzles To gain favour with The Sink Gods, you must solve the tests within their temples. Within the temples are many moderate/difficult puzzles for you to solve! Story and Atmosphere The Sink Gods is a funny game with unique humour that doesn’t take itself seriously. Language support The Sink Gods is officially supported in 3 languages: -English -Spanish -Kosraen (Kosraen translation is a little janky)
row.short_description: The Sink Gods is a modern adventure game. You play a poor villager who lives in the Sink Valley. When you are evicted from your home, you realise your only hope is the Sink Gods of the Great Basin. Journey to each of their temples, and pass their test to gain revenge for what you have lost.

row.name: Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium

Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium: Mini-Album features a variety of tunes from some of Capcom's most beloved arcade classics, including Mega Man: The Power Battle and Street Fighter Alpha 3 ! About the Game Play more of your favorite arcade hits from yesteryear. Includes SONSON for free! Capcom is taking you back to the stadium with another collection of your favorite classic hits! Come see what's changed, and what's completely new, in Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium! Just Like the Good Old Days From 3D-rendered arcade cabinets to scanline filters, there's everything you need to recreate that arcade atmosphere. Fully customizable display settings let you craft your own personal experience and truly relive the glory days of arcade gaming. Brand New Ways to Play With gameplay rewind, speed adjustment, and the ability to save and load your game at any time, your old favorites will feel new all over again! Every game has online leaderboard rankings, so you can see where you stack up against players all over the world! Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium, where retro appeal meets cutting-edge features for a fresh take on Capcom's classics! Play hard. Dominate the scoreboards. Track your progress across each game, including play count, times cleared, and personal high scores! Beat your bests, or those of your friends--there's always something to shoot/strive for! Included Title SonSon Players: 1-2 Co-Op Genre: Shooting Versions: Japanese & English Note: Player numbers differ based on the game. Multiplayer gameplay is only available locally.

row.name: Infinite Lagrange
row.detailed_description: We have extended our presence to one-third of the Milky Way with a gigantic transportation network—the Lagrange System. Different forces strike to make their own way in the world and desire the control of the Lagrange system. You, emerging as one of the force leaders, find yourself in a time of challenges and opportunities. Your fleet pioneers into the space unknown where war and sabotage may lie ahead. Are you determined to achieve something great out there or go back to the safety of home? From 0 to Infitnite Into the unknown galaxy, you have only a small city with two frigate. Through mining, building and trade, expand your base and territory, attain better ship-building technology and carry more weight in the intergalactic space. Customized Weapon System You may even modify and upgrade the weapon system on every single ship, if you ever want to tap into your creative side. It’s up to you to bring out the fleet’s full potential. Boundless Ship Combos Spore Fighter, Destroyer, Constantine the Great, Solar Whale Carrier...... With a myriad of ships and aircraft available, there’s really no saying about what kind of fleet you might put together with your unwearying ingenuity. Realistic Space Massive Battles In a space battle, a well-planned ambush can severely damage the enemy fleet. Or you can choose to guard thoroughfares with your fleet. A major battle could create a no-fly zone of hundreds of miles' radius. Venture Deep into Uncharted Space In a corner of the Milky Way, you will have your own base and view, beyond that is the vast unknown space. You will send your fleet to the dark frontiers where anything can happen. What else will you find other than stars? Interact with Interstellar Forces There are forces taking up parts of the universe. You can help them achieve their goals by sending ships to their aid, cooperate and prosper, or, instead, occupy their airspace and territory. There are countless unknown quests waiting for you. How would you choose? You Will Need Allies This is a dynamic society, where cooperation and conflict happen every day. Join or form alliance with global players. Expand territory and spread faith throughout the galaxy. You will enter a robust universe where you can strike for common prosperity with diplomacy or remain detached. It's thrilling to command the battle with a close view from all angles, and the 3D graphics rival any blockbusters. Only this time, you're the lead in the enchanting space.
row.short_description: Different forces strive to make their own way in the space and desire the control of the Lagrange system- a gigantic transportation network. You, emerging as one of the force leaders, find yourself in a time of challenges and opportunities.

row.name: Time on Frog Island - Prologue
row.detailed_description: Awakened from his daydream by a falling star crashing into a far-off island, the sailor changes his heading and sets off to investigate. After landing on the island, the sailor crosses paths with a shifty old shaman who steals their pet plant. Using cunning, guile and skill the sailor must aid the shaman with a mysterious ritual and help restore the island to its former glory. Only then can the treasured plant be returned and the sailor's journey recommenced. Fulfil the prophecy Make your own path in this island sandbox, you never know what will be around the next corner! Help the shaman restore the island to its former glory. Solve interesting puzzles to get your hands on required items. Run faster, jump higher, fall slower, anything is possible if you're holding the right item. Each object you pick up could end up being the key to something bigger.
row.short_description: Help an old axolotl bring life back to a dying island in the Time on Frog Island Prologue - a small, self-contained, mini adventure and prelude to the full Trading Time game. Download the prologue for free and be sure to wishlist the full game if you enjoyed this first mini-adventure.

row.name: Momentum
row.detailed_description: Momentum is a fast-paced racing game in a retro 80's neon style. Race against your friends in this easy to learn, hard to master couch pvp racing game, where you control your hover car around a gravity defying, twisting and turning racetrack. Use your hover car's grapple hook to swing yourself around corners at full speed, take shortcuts and make various other maneuvers. Just make sure you detach on time! For some extra speed, collect the various momentum charges found all over the track, to enable your boost to overtake your friends! Beat your friends at all of the three tracks in this game! This game was developed by 3rd years students at Howest - Digital Arts & Entertainment Christina Fekkes Michael Bellekens Quinten Vanhooydonck Ruben Van Ostaeyen Silke Nemegeer
row.short_description: Fast-paced racing game in a retro 80's neon style.

row.name: Trial Of Empires TD
row.detailed_description: Trial of Empires TD offers a detailed tower defense game far from simplicity to players. Progress your playstyle with your Army, Ally, Spell Upgrades, Target Detections, In-Game Buffs, Ammo System and more. Ally You can pick 19 allies from the real world and each have unique spells to strengthen your army. Army Archers, Element Towers, Soldiers, Rocket Towers, Machine Guns and Tanks. Each army has a different attack type and unique bonus effects for diversing your strategy. Highlights Single Player or Multiplayer Co-Op gameplay Enemy AI Pathfinding System and Maze playstyle 6 army types and 77 realistic / futuristic towers with various effects and equipments Miscellaneous type of enemies Detailed tower information and statistics Unlimited gameplay and different combinations Leaderboards, Achievements, In-Game Purchases and Community

row.name: The Last Shape
row.detailed_description: Sink into the Breathtaking Atmosphere of a Destroyed World Somewhere, among an endless void there was a universe named Gaos. The universe was inhabited by 4 races of creatures that were similar to geometrical figures. The relationships between them were hostile. The whole world was destroyed as a result of the war. Adventure Through the Looking Glass Finally spirits of the dead have been reincarnated as the last shape, that was a little cube, which gave them an ability to see what they've done when they were alive in a different light. row.name: Pong Temple
row.detailed_description: Set in a fantasy atmosphere inspired by Incan mythology, Pong Temple takes the well-known gameplays of Pong and Brick Breaker and mixes them into a procedural dungeon crawler focused on action and reflexes. Explore the temple, collect resources to create custom playable rooms and share them on the Workshop, collect artifacts to become stronger, and complete 18 challenges to unlock new artifacts that will help you conquer the temple.
row.short_description: Set in a fantasy atmosphere inspired by Incan mythology, Pong Temple takes the well-known gameplays of Pong and Brick Breaker and mixes them into a procedural dungeon crawler focused on action and reflexes.

row.name: Squared Up
row.detailed_description: Squared Up is an adventure puzzle game that puts you in the role of Cubert, a 3-dimensional shape who has fallen into the 2nd dimension. Use Cubert's 3rd dimensions powers of changing shape and color to help you solve puzzles and get him back home. 3 Levels to Explore 15+ Puzzles to Solve Uncover the history of the link between the 3rd and 2nd dimensions Talk to inhabitants of the 2D world to learn about their lives Puzzle Types Move Boxes to Clear Paths Change colors and toggle walls to navigate mazes of color Guide ice blocks to their desired end points Reflect lazers to a desired location to open paths Sneak past guards Navigate mazes of disappearing walls And more
row.short_description: Join Cubert, a 3rd dimensional shape, on his quest to escape the 2nd dimension. Navigate puzzles by morphing Cubert's form and interacting with the world to escape back to the 3rd dimension.

row.name: Capital Island
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Capital Island This island has seen better days... now, they all wait hope knock on their door. You as a door-to-door seller will help Capital Island prosper again (while making some profit, of course!). Choose Your Hero To help you accomplish this mission, you'll have the company of Isla or Brody . That's no wrong choice here. Both are ready to make deals. Knock Knock Knock Each day you have to go door to door offering products from your catalog and making deals with the residents. Some will buy, some will offer a trade, some will ask for a donation... and others will just ignore you. But. nothing like a day after another, right? With your notebook, you keep track of your clients' requests and never get lost (since you have a map there too). Every morning your dealer's boat docks at the pier and you can shop to fulfill your customers' requests or sell when there are too many items (or too few coins). After that, just pack your bag and you're good to go! Let's Talk About Business When the island begins to evolve, new islanders will migrate and build new homes. And some will grab the opportunity to open their own businesses. That will also give you the possibility of different negotiations. And, who knows, maybe some interesting investments. Capital Island is waiting for you! Now, go knock on some doors...
row.short_description: Play as a Door-to-Door seller in this trade/management game.

row.name: Puppet Master: The Game
row.detailed_description: THE PUPPETS ARE BACK! October Games and Full Moon Features proudly introduce Puppet Master: The Game! This free-to-play online multiplayer game celebrates the series' 30-year legacy. Revisit iconic locations, select from a large roster of playable characters from the movies, and play a variety of online multiplayer game modes, each inspired by the Puppet’s many adventures. FREE, NO STRINGS ATTACHED! Enjoy our free-to-play multiplayer game without paywalls. All maps and characters are accessible for free. If you love it, consider supporting us with our cosmetic-only skin packs, each inspired by the Puppet Master film series! ONLINE MULTIPLAYER Unleash carnage across 4 game modes inspired by the film series! (Thief COOP or 3vs1) Flip the Asymmetrical Multiplayer Horror Game norm: play as a lone human against three sinister puppets. Survive as the human by stealing secrets of reanimation and escaping, or protect your master's secrets as the puppets. Unleash a pint-sized siege of terror! (Manhunt 4vs2) Two Human players must lift a curse and escape alive while fighting off an endless assault of heinous Puppets. Humans must stand near the Sutekh Idols to lift the curse. (Puppet Master 4v4) Three Good Puppet players defend one Human Player against a group of four Evil Totem Players! The Human must escape while the Good Puppets protect their Master! (Puppet Wars 4v4) In this Puppet-Only Game mode, two factions battle to determine the deadliest tiny terror. The first team to reach XP limit wins! PUPPET MAYHEM Play as a variety of malicious little fiends ripped straight from the film series, spanning iconic characters like Blade, Jester, and Six Shooter, as well as deep cuts from the franchise like the Totem and Mephisto. And officially, for the first time, the Puppets crossover with another twisted Full Moon Features franchise, Demonic Toys. Play as the foul-mouthed Baby Oopsie Daisy or the manic Jack-Attack and many more! It's pint-sized mayhem! TOULON’S JOURNALS A Sandbox Single Player mode where you can complete objectives and unlock pages of Andre Toulon’s Journal. Collect them all and listen to the Puppet Master’s journey throughout the series. Written by Nat Brehmer the author of the Puppet Master Complete: A Franchise History. THE PUPPET TRUNK Craft your own team of tiny terrors! Play the game and earn XP to unlock iconic alternate looks from the series. Customize your weapons and express yourself with Emotes! Roll Perks to make your Puppet as deadly as they can be. Make each character your own!
row.short_description: This free-to-play online multiplayer game celebrates the series' 30-year legacy. Revisit iconic locations, select from a large roster of playable characters from the movies, and play a variety of online multiplayer game modes, each inspired by the Puppet’s many adventures.

row.name: Haunted Hell House
row.detailed_description: This game is a horror action ADV where you explore a creepy mansion. You avoid damaging gimmicks and clown and get keys as you go. Certain objects can be examined, and the perspective becomes first person. You can return to the title screen from the menu screen. You can use keyboard or XBOX360 and PS4 controller to control the game. Save the game automatically when you switch stages. Japanese and English are available, and you can switch between them on the title screen. The game can be made full-screen by pressing the F1 key. October 22, 2022 Episode 2 added.
row.short_description: Horror action ADV to enjoy the fear.
row.notes: Please note that there are violent and cruel scenes in this game.

row.name: ITRP _ Gas Prison
row.detailed_description: In fact, a short description of this game has deceived you. You will be required not only to be attentive, but also to react in a timely manner, to have intelligence and a good memory. ITRP _ Gas Prison will allow you to arrange a little test. You will find yourself in a system of cells, each of which can slam and poison you with gas. Keep an eye on the indicators to prevent this. However, the conditions under which you will be placed will not allow you to save all cells. Some will have to be sacrificed. And there are few useless ones among them: Some contain maps or timers. Some stores interactive monitors for system management. Some just has a lot of passages. The game is NOT designed to test your reflexes, reaction, accuracy or ...patience. It is designed to test your attentiveness, intelligence, ability to think ahead. Even if you need time to get used to and remember the location of the functional points, nevertheless, you will learn the detailed rules inside.
row.short_description: 10 minutes and you are free. Only 10 minutes and you will not be asked for anything else. Stay in these cells for 10 minutes and you don't have to come back here anymore. But at the same time, only one condition is required of you..... Be attentive.

row.name: 夢獸之島Isles of Monsters
row.detailed_description: 「銀河穹夢」已經開始失控了。 居住在夢獸之島的馴夢師一族，千年以來與人類和平共處，但島上的夢獸卻因為貪食過多人類噩夢而凶暴化，這使得銀河穹夢開始逐漸崩壞。 玩家將擔任年輕的馴夢師，回到過去尋找各種恢復世界的情報。一路上會遇到許多臺灣文壇上的知名文人，只要幫助他們解決難關，便能得到情報。現在就進入夢獸之島，從中收集到讓夢獸恢復正常的能量，幫助夢獸的世界恢復和平吧！ 本遊戲為第一人稱射擊VR遊戲。以奇幻島嶼為概念，從葉石濤、張深切、龍瑛宗、林海音、姚一葦這五位作家取得靈感，從臺文館的3D掃描藏品：葉石濤的「藤椅」、張深切徒步旅行的「名人題字錄」、龍瑛宗的輪椅、林海音精心收藏的象偶、姚一葦渡海的皮箱設計成關卡道具，使小朋友透過遊戲，對台灣文學家感覺不陌生。 ￭扮演訓夢師的腳色，進入充滿奇妙幻獸世界的第一人稱射擊遊戲。 ￭以國立臺灣文學館數位典藏進行發想，公開向大眾徵選遊戲腳本，為台灣第一款文學遊戲。 ￭引用文學家葉石濤比喻作家就像一頭「 吃夢獸」作為遊戲名稱與發想概念，藉由冒險旅程，帶領大家了解文學家的小知識。 ￭支援Windows 本遊戲部份情節含有閃光效應，有些人可能會出現光敏感性症狀，請遊戲前評估或諮詢醫生。 遊戲時間為15-25分鐘左右，建議遊玩的總體時間切勿過長，若感到疲累、昏昏欲睡或精疲力竭時，請不要玩遊戲。 由於遊戲是沉浸式的真實體驗，請事先將周圍環境清空，保留足夠的遊玩範圍，確保自己在安全環境中玩遊戲。
row.short_description: 由臺灣文學館推出的《夢獸之島》，從葉石濤、張深切、龍瑛宗、林海音、姚一葦這五位作家取得靈感，設計成各種不同關卡，為第一人稱射擊VR遊戲。

row.name: 狂神无双

All of the sisters (Inchester, Imingter and Iekler) take in refugees to a location deep underground. row.name: Time Idle RPG
row.detailed_description: Wishlist my upcoming Steam game! Time Idle RPG is an idle incremental game with prestige and multiple layers of game mechanic unlocks. Each seconds that passes in real life is one second you can use in the multiple mechanics found in the game. As the game mechanics unfold, you will find yourself making decisions on how to assign the Time that you have gathered so far to optimize your gains. This game will gather Time and resources while not played. Featured Mechanics: 500+ Unlockable Sacred Timeline Tree Nodes (2) Layers of Prestige (Synchronization & Time Travel) Gathering Building Capturing Crafting Combat & Experience Equipment, Skill Runes, & Pets Passive Skill Tree Jobs Endless Tower Combat & Talents Derivatives Timers Raids Permanent Daily and Hourly rewards Cross platform save/loading (Steam + Android + iOS) Cross platform leaderboards (Steam + Android + iOS) Settings Tutorial Unfolding gameplay Steam achievement Local game achievements

row.name: Babble Royale
row.detailed_description: Somewhere, deep in the Siberian wilderness, 26 letters play a deadly game of survival. Babble Royale is a game of high-speed, word-based combat. You are the last word you made. Eliminate an opponent by quickly connecting your word to theirs, before they do. 16 Players - 1 Winner Have the last word, or die trying. Stay Alive The deadly hot zone is creeping in from the edges of the map, forcing players together for the final showdown. Collect Loot From fallen enemies and power-ups scattered around the map. Level Up Earn money by making words. Spend money to get more letters faster, and acquire powerful items from the shop. Win Through raw word-making ability or by outwitting your opponents with clever tactics. Golden Royales ???? ??? ??? ? ??????? ???? ?? ??? ???? ? ?????? ?????? ????? ????? ??? ????? ?? ? ?????? ??????. Customize Express your inner Babbler. The store has a range of skins, hats, and emotes for you to earn or purchase. We made Babble Royale for competitive gamers who like smart games, and casual gamers who like intense competition. The combination of classic word-making gameplay with fast-paced tactical action means the game is easy to learn but has an insanely high skill ceiling. Season Zero is our early access launch. Earn money and collect loot to upgrade your abilities, outrun the deadly hot zone, and outwit or outlast all your opponents to have the Last Word!

row.name: The House Where They Dwell
row.detailed_description: In this first-person action thriller, play as the hosts of a popular ghost hunting show that is normally staged for views as they discover that this house is truly filled with horrors. Explore a randomly generated mansion, find items to aid you, and kill the spiders infesting the area as you fight to escape The House Where They Dwell . EXPLORE THE MANSION Explore a randomly generated mansion as you collect items to aid you against the mysterious spider infestation! KILL SPIDERS Watch out! Spiders will increase in size until they are large enough to attack you. Shrink them back down with 'SpiderX' Spray and schmack them when they are small enough! DESTROY SPIDER NESTS Watch out for spider nests throughout the house, they seem to be where the spiders are coming from. Luckily, you can douse the nests and set them ablaze with 'Flickers' lighter fluid and matches!
row.short_description: The House Where They Dwell is a first-person action thriller game from Half Brain Games, LLC. Play as the hosts of a popular ghost hunting show that is normally staged for views and discover for yourself the true horrors that dwell within this mysterious mansion.

In addition, the following improvements and bug fixes have been made: 2D background name wrong Hotkey parameter name is different from option Fixed the problem that the face compensation parameters were occasionally not automatically captured after setting the camera If you have any questions, you can ask them on facebook and twitter: @qb_makerstudio About the Software V-Skin is a tool that combines Live2D and 3D VTuber Capture facial expressions through WebCam and IOS applications, and use somatosensory devices to make body movements perfectly combine the human and the virtual character.
