row.name: SCP: Containment Breach Multiplayer
row.detailed_description: Multiplayer survival horror game based on stories from the SCP Foundation. The game is about a facility called Site-[REDACTED] containing anomalous entities known as SCPs. When a catastrophic containment breach occurs at one of the facilities, it is your main goal to get out of the facility. SCP:CB Multiplayer has different gamemode, called breach mode, you and other players can become one of the staff/anomalous entities and experience breach from another perspective. SCP:CB Multiplayer breach gamemode currently has 9 playable SCP entities, and overall more than 30 SCP entities. Multiplayer Features: Containment Breach : Co-op and Multiplayer Containment Breach with up to 64 players. Breach Gamemode : Multiplayer gamemode, where you can become SCP entity, guards, etc. Random Sites : Our random site generator gives a new facility every time you play. Map Creator : Create, design and play your own custom map, for use in game. Frequent Updates : New content and bug fixes will be frequently added. Community : An active development team that puts the community feedback first. Playable SCP list: SCP-049 , SCP-049-2 , SCP-096 , SCP-106 , SCP-173 , SCP-939 , SCP-860-2 , SCP-035 , SCP-966 . Play the game with up to 64 players!
row.short_description: Multiplayer survival horror game based on stories from the SCP Foundation. The game is about a facility containing anomalous entities known as SCPs. When a catastrophic containment breach occurs at one of the facilities, it is your main goal to escape the facility. Try to escape with your friends!
row.notes: Includes gore, violence and drug use. Gore and violence usually occurs in tandem with the use of firearms and the likes.

row.name: Owlone in the Woods
row.detailed_description: While hunting for food for its chicks, an owl is struck by lightning and wakes up to find both its ability to fly and its chicks gone. Now you must brave the dangers of the forest floor and canopy to find your chicks and bring them back home. Recover your ability to navigate the forest in four short levels and try to bring back as many mice home to your chicks that have spent the night - Owlone in the Woods. Owlone in the Woods is a cute and condensed miniature platformer where you unlock new movement options with each chick you rescue from the forest. Owlone in the Woods features: Original music with five tracks that your chicks hoot in rhythm to. Charming(?) accompanying sound design made with books, socks, cutlery and those dry leaves I found in the pot of my avocado plant. Dash, jump, climb and fly your way to each chick - and then bring them back to the safety of the hollow of your tree. Eat mice to heal - or if you're already full - regurgitate the meal to your chicks and increase your highscore for your current run. Compete for highest score, shortest completion time, and least deaths between runs in the local leaderboard. Fully supported by both keyboard and gamepads. Expect a bit of a challenge and approximately 1 hour's worth of pixel critters in peril.
row.short_description: Help an owl find its chicks after losing them - and the ability to fly - in a thunderstorm. In this short 2D platformer you slowly recover your ability to navigate the dangers of the forest as you bring your chicks back to your hollow one by one.

row.name: Maze Mania: The Ultimate 3D Maze Game Playtest
Cyndefense 2
row.detailed_description: Cyndefense 2 is a well crafted, hardcore, tower defense game. While there are easier modes for those who want casual game-play, the game will test your ability to manage your resources and rely on superb tower placement in order to be capable of beating harder maps. While there is no obvious story or goal other than to beat the final wave, there are some hidden bits of lore you can learn throughout the game. You are the Tower Master of this world and will use all your defenses to stop the Last Bastion's minions from initiating the Incyneration, which would lead to the ultimate destruction of your world. You can fight across 8 atmospheric maps, one of which is only unlocked after having completed all other maps in the hardest difficulty, each with their own unique song/song style, and obtain Victory Gems for beating each one. You have 8 unique towers to choose from with most of them having 25 completely unique and intriguing upgrades. If that's not good enough then you can earn Tokens from completing each map, which you can then use to unlock a brand new difficulty, or to purchase any of 8 extremely powerful Powers.
row.short_description: Cyndefense 2 is a well crafted, hardcore, tower defense game. While there are easier modes for those who want casual game-play, the game will test your ability to manage your resources and rely on superb tower placement in order to be capable of beating harder maps.

row.name: Project Vostok: Episode 1
row.detailed_description: 'Project Vostok' is a non-linear horror visual novel about a group of airplane crash survivors finding a mysterious Soviet-era bunker in Russian mountains. A plane flying from Moscow to Barnaul crashes in the Altai Mountains because of a crew error. Almost two dozen strangers are left there to survive. An indefinite list of their problems includes injuries, lack of food, risk of being frozen to death, and conflicts inside the group. Things take a massive shift when the survivors find an abandoned Soviet bunker built in a cave. Warm rooms and an abundance of supplies lead them to move to this mysterious location. However, it soon turns out that all the problems they have encountered earlier were nothing compared with what is awaiting them now. Expected release date of the free first episode is 11 of January 2023.
row.short_description: 'Project Vostok' is a non-linear horror visual novel about a group of airplane crash survivors finding a mysterious Soviet-era bunker in Altai mountains. Uncover the story full of drama, horrors and decide the fate a of various cast of heroes in this free visual novel.
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Violence, Blood, and textual description of Scenes of Sex, including non-consensual ones.

row.name: Experiment Of Being
row.detailed_description: You are a scientist dedicated to prove simulation theory by transferring your consciousness into a super computer. Find clues and solve puzzles and perform an experiment of being. Features First person 'escape the room puzzle' game Perform an experiment before your nemesis will come to stop you Solve puzzles to find out how to perform your experiment Professional voice overs This is a solo dev project. I hope you will enjoy it. Follow for future projects on instagram: and twitter:
row.short_description: Escape the room game with a story

row.name: DaVinCo
row.detailed_description: A picture is worth a thousand words - then how much more could you tell others through your 3D data in a virtual environment? Meet with friends/colleagues/partners online and put your 3D data front and center. Host or join a multi-user session to present and discuss your 3D results - easily, collaboratively, intuitively. DaVinCo is intendet to be ... - a modern way to present individual 3d data sets in virtual space. - an easy way to host/join collaborative meeting spaces. - an intuitive way of communication - visuell, auditiv, textuell. - an extensive way due to its wide range of file formats. - a flexible way to upload session 3D data - URL, host upload. - a versatile way to move, rotate, scale, measure, label. - a reliably way to load and store session states. DaVinCo is meant to be for ... - scientists who want to discuss their results in 3D. - students who look for a virtual learning environment. - AND anyone else who needs more than pure video conferencing.
row.short_description: DaVinCo (Data Visualization in Collaboration) lets you host/join an online space for the visualization of 3D data in various formats. It is designed to allow groups of scientists to experience and discuss their data collaboratively in a shared virtual 3D desktop/VR environment.

row.name: East Trapper
row.detailed_description: Update An update coming next week, 1st november * Added new levels * Added a timer on screen that stops once completed About the Game Looking for an adventure game with traps to keep you on your toes! Then look no further! To complete this game you must make your way through different levels of traps with twists and turns. Future level updates will be made available! 'I had a blast playing this game' - Left4Dead 2 No.1 jockey, Old Man Scraps Features - 2D Adventure game - Hidden Traps to figure out - 9 'Levels' to complete with more to come - Once completed you can try to complete in the fastest time
row.short_description: A 2D adventure game with traps to keep you on your toes.

row.name: Fragment Hunters
row.detailed_description: Crystal Souls: Fragment Hunters is a top down indie space game where you shoot enemy ships, gather crystals, and upgrade your own ship. You're a soldier aboard the Crystal Shark, tasked with finding and retrieving the mysterious missing crystals. You choose a level, after which it becomes a horde-survival game. As you survive the onslaught of enemy ships around you, you are able to collect the crystals you need. The further you progress, the more items and ships you unlock. The longer you survive, the higher your rewards become. Every weapon and ship has its own pros and cons. Some are more geared for long range, others short range. Experiment and find a setup that you like. Aim at enemies, shoot enemies, pick up items, mine some ore, what more do you need?
row.short_description: Crystal Souls: Fragment Hunters is a top down indie space game where you shoot enemy ships, gather crystals, and upgrade your own ship.

row.name: Hope Despair Chaos
row.detailed_description: Game unsupported announcement Due to difficult in maintaining and revenue result, the game will stop receive updates or support from developers. Even so, everyone is welcome to try and play the game if they want. About the Game A new real time social deduction game, each players starts with a public Talent ( skill ) and a hidden independent Faction (winning condition) , real time lightning, flashlight management and hiding in shadow. Welcome to Hope Despair Chaos ! A game about Hope Cultivation programs and includes some of the Despair elements to stimulate the best outcome possiple. Join the program and may the fortune of luck let you be one among us, Symbols of Hope . Those remain evil will be chosen as Symbol of Despair , atempting to eliminate everything. Top Features: - When game starts, each player is given 1 Talent ( skill ), 1 Faction (winning condition) . They are independent meaning a Doctor can be Hope Doc or Despair Doc or Chaos Doc or any faction possiple. - Current talents list : Talentless, Plumber, Assassin, Engineer, Scout, Bartender, Doctor, Streamer, Lawyer, Fashion Model, Runner, Dreamer. - When you are killed, you leave an Encrypted Victim Message behind. - Crime scene investigation with flashlight, decrypting victim message and looking for the true murder location . - Real time shadow allow you to hide in shadow for real, as well as hiding a body . - Personal flash light with limit battery allow you to show off your management skill. - 5 cloth slot fully customiable for your fashion talents to shine. - You only need one copy of a cloth to wear it on your character in game. Feel free to trade or market your surplus cloths as you want. Most of cloths are tradable, marketable following Steam policy. Features: - Multiplayer real time casual assassinating and investigating game. - Playable from 1 to 10 players. - SPECIAL 2+ players game mode: : All player start as Symbol of Hope. Those first players to finish all tasks become Senior Symbol of Despair. - Each player start game with a unique talent benefit to all factions, ready to cook your master plan right from the begining. - Room host have extensive controls (see below). - Faction evidences scatter around the map, enjoy the treasures hunter experience, burn or share evidences just as plan. - 3D environment to show off your camera work. - Each room has their own light switch button , limit power hub to charge light. - Everyone can vote to return to waiting room safely , without remake a new room. - Player colors are fully customized , everyone can use a same color if need. - Voice chat . Factions: - Each player belongs to 1 faction when a game starts. There are special talents which CHANGES faction of a player. Symbols of Hope - The ultimate good faction . - Objective: Overthrow Symbols of Despair. Symbols of Despair - The lose at the end faction . - There are 2 rank: Senior, Ultimate. Each rank gives players additional talents. - Objective: Overthrow Symbols of Hope. Symbols of Chaos - The **** faction. - Objective: Get voted out. Chaos Slayer - The meme faction . - Objective: Personally slay exactly 1 member of each of faction: Hope, Despair, Chaos. Talents: - Host of a room can fully customize the talents pool, all assassins or all fashion models as you wish. - Host can config to play with Talentless pool, everyone has no talent . - Each player possesses 1 talent when a game starts. - Each talent gives players a way to be different, a chance to role play, a challenge to actually win. Talents list (update to newest version): - Talentless, Plumber, Assassin, Engineer, Scout, Bartender, Doctor, Streamer, Lawyer, Fashion Model, Runner, Dreamer. - Luck talent is not available and under research. Only Room host has these powers ! - Kick a player out of room, no question ask. - Make Entrance Test to filter compatible players against the host. - Config Force premade name to manage game environment. - Config Talents pool , all lawyers or all doctors as you wish. - Other features...
row.short_description: A new real time social deduction game, each players starts with a public Talent ( skill ) and a hidden independent Faction (winning condition), real time lightning, flashlight management and hiding in shadow.

row.name: Limita Luminii
row.detailed_description: Limita Luminii este primul joc VR românesc cu conținut în limba română, cu o poveste localizată și relevantă cultural. O experiență artistică în VR - inedită prin apropierea artelor unanim recunoscute (high-art) și artele noilor medii (gaming). Marcat în copilărie de trauma Primului Război Mondial, un pictor român trăiește în 1939 panica începerii unei noi tragedii, clacând treptat și evadând în spațiul abstract al propriei arte. Vizitează un colț de mahala din Bucureștiul interbelic, explorând un univers inspirat din documente și mărturisiri istorice ale perioadei, care integrează în poveste evenimente reale: atacul Bucureștiului în primul război mondial cu zepeline, recrutarea artiștilor plastici pe front în divizii de propagandă, etc. Descoperă scenografia narativă construită vizual realist, navigând printr-un sistem nou de locomoție in VR - în acord cu povestea personajului principal rănit la picior - cu ajutorul unui baston. În joc se regăsesc lucrări de artă reale ale perioadei interbelice, curatoriate de Muzeul de Arta Recentă - MARe din colecția proprie și colecția Cristinel Popa, alături de lucrări originale pictate de artistul Lucian Sandu-Milea. Acum ai ocazia de a testa în avanpremieră primul joc VR românesc cu conținut în limba română, “Limita Luminii”, ce va fi lansat oficial în curând. Proiectul este susținut și co-finanțat de Administrația Fondului Cultural Național (AFCN).
row.short_description: Joc narativ în realitate virtuală. Marcat în copilărie de trauma Primului Război Mondial, un pictor român trăiește în 1939 panica începerii unei noi tragedii, clacând treptat și evadând în spațiul abstract al propriei arte.

row.name: Hotel on the Grate
row.detailed_description: Hotel on the Grate is a short, (like 15 to 20 minutes) narrative adventure game. Assume the role of an on call therapist and travel across the city on the grate to meet your patients. Features Include: Meet and talk to interesting characters! Track progress with your Journal! Explore multiple locations! Diverse music! At least ten words of dialog! At least ten minutes of gameplay! Developed in the Godot engine
row.short_description: Hotel on the Grate is a short(15-20 min), narrative adventure game. Assume the role of an on call therapist and travel across the city on the grate to meet your patients.
row.notes: Hotel on the Grate contains swearing and vulgar allusions to sex, also depression is a theme.

row.name: Saboteur
row.detailed_description: New 1 vs 4 Multiplayer Map Saboteur Must Deliver an Item Security Has Flashlights For the Darkness Saboteur Has Nightvision For the Darkness New Single Player Campaign! Begin your journey as the Saboteur on your mission of destruction. Play the first mission right now and the rest as they are released in the future. With new gameplay features expanding with each mission and all new interactions and cinematics for a better single player experience. New Gameplay Features Fully voiced dialogue system Quest objectives Cinematics New Single Player Mode: Sole Survivor! Do what it takes to survive the rage of rampaging aliens. Multiplayer: In a game of one versus up to six other players both teams need to use observational skills and planning to succeed. On the main map there are 12 objectives spread across three floors. You have 30 minutes. There are 6 Security Forces and the Saboteur only needs 6 objectives to win. Play too passive as Security and you lose. Play too aggressively as the Saboteur and you'll give yourself away. Security has to be careful though, kill a scientist and the Saboteur wins. Kill the Saboteur and you win. If the Saboteur can't get enough objectives in time Security wins. The Saboteur You have to achieve your objective of sabotaging enough critical areas while blending in with the AI controlled scientists. Don't draw any unwanted attention. Observe and mimic the scientists. You have several tools to your advantage, like the ability to sabotage lights and doors among others. With greater mobility you can outmanoeuvre Security Forces if you play smart. Security Forces Deduce the identity of the Saboteur by observing the scientists. Patrol and defend the critical stations from sabotage. Work together with the rest of the Security Force, communication is key.
row.short_description: A Saboteur has infiltrated a science team on a space station, trying to bring it down. The Security forces must now find an eliminate him, without killing any innocent scientists, before the station goes critical.

row.name: 全托教师
row.detailed_description: 你是不是做了十来年学生，对学生时期有种特别感情？害怕、厌倦或者是加入工作后的后悔、羡慕…… 现在你来当老师吧，现在你成为了一名周末全托实验班的全托教师，你可以根据你的喜好安排学生周末期间的生活和学习，让他们专研某一课程，或者雨露均沾什么都学。 他们掌握知识、技能的程度会直接影响他们的人生走向，最终走向结局。 你会有4个学生，他们性格各异，有的勤奋好学，有的吊儿郎当，也有的随波逐流。他们不会一开始就加入，而是随时间陆陆续续加入你的全托班。 开始你的游戏 做好自己工作日的计划，做好学生休息日的日程安排。然后点击【继续】，时间会流逝到下一个日程时刻，反反复复。 学生他爹说想让他考一本，但是学生说他只想玩一辈子。你作为一个 “老师” 该怎么选择呢？拼命补课，还是开心就好。或者让他见识见识世界之大。 学生总是想跑出去？没关系，打不得骂不得，自己躺平就好了，随它去吧。 我没钱怎么办？小事，工作日的时候多多去做兼职，直播卖货是个不错的选择！ 工作日 工作日作为你的“假期”，你可以选择深耕某一学习方法，也可以去为全托班赚点外快。 工作日期间学生们都在学校，且晚上会有强制性的晚自习，所以即使他们晚上会回全托班住宿，但是你不能过多干涉他们，因为他们实在太累了。 我是正经教师，为什么要给商家直播带货？因为商家给的实在太多了。 休息日 休息日的到来，意味着你可以给学生们安排周末的生活了，这也是你工作的重心。让他们“加班”补课？或者给他们培养兴趣。或者好好休息，减轻压力。都可以！ 或许你觉得周末也上课是不是太高压了？......好像是有那么一点，但是住校生全部都是这样的，大家都在拼命学习，凭什么全托班就不能开课了。 可以安排课程怎么这么少？只有九大科目？你可以在 世界-科技中心 中订阅一些其他的课程，这很重要！ 高考 第三年的最后几天，会进行高考。如果你培养的学生很优秀，那真是太棒了！以后公立全托班会席卷整个黑湖市！你也会成为黑湖市的教育界传奇。 如果你培养的学生很一般，那很抱歉，或许这个实验性质的全托班再也不会开办了。你将回归高中教师的团队，在学校里继续发光发热。 若干年后 许多年后，你会看到你曾经培养的学生。他们的人生，会因你变得更美好吗？ 如果他们没有你期望的那么好，你还可以再试一次！ 关于开源 本游戏源代码已开源到Github，
row.short_description: 扮演一位能够管理高中生周末学习生活的全托教师，通过计划版周五安排他们的周末日程，一直持续三年。你可以让他们周末补课，冲击高考；也可以让他们随心所欲，增长见识；更可以让他们培养兴趣，为理想努力。3年后的高考是你高光时间。而多年后他们会回来，看看你培养出来的未来之子吧！

row.name: Urbek City Builder: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Urbek City Builder: Prologue is a free game where you will be able to build a city of your own design! Manage its natural resources, improve the quality of life of the population, and build its neighbourhoods in your own way. Neighbourhoods Breathe life into your city by building different neighbourhoods. Do you want a bohemian neighbourhood? Build bars, parks and libraries, but keep a low population density nearby. Do you want a bourgeois neighbourhood? You need parks and luxury shops. Manage There is no money in Urbek. Instead, you will have to build everything with your own resources, such as food, coal, or skilled work. There are more than 30 different resources to manage! Manage your natural resources well, so that they do not run out before they can be replaced. How will you choose to produce the energy for your inhabitants and industries? Educate Education is fundamental! By producing enough qualified work and scientific work, you will be able to build more advanced buildings. Observe Move around at street level in order to get a more intimate sense of the city you are creating. See and feel the differences between neighborhoods the way your city’s residents do! Organic growth The growth of your city will be organic. Some constructions will appear according to the surrounding conditions. For example, buildings with more than two floors will appear in densely populated areas and with basic services. You can place other buildings by yourself, but they need some conditions. For instance, the local market needs to be close to the farms. The university should have some high schools nearby, which, in turn, require nearby schools. When it comes to designing your city, you have a variety of viable options. There are no buildings that are superior to others. Every decision will have its pros and cons. Bourgeois houses consume more food and need resources that cost more to produce, but will improve the quality of life of the residents there. On the other hand, improving the productivity of industries will produce more resources, but will diminish the quality of life for residents living in the area.
row.short_description: Urbek City Builder: Prologue is a free city building game where you can build your own neighbourhoods: from nightlife district to industrial district. Don't exhaust your natural resources before you have an educated population to build more efficient structures. Try it yourself for free!

row.name: Car Manufacture: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Check out the main game: About the Game CAR MANUFACTURE - PROLOGUE Car Manufacture: Prologue is a shortened version of a game about building and managing a car factory. This version of the game is limited to a tutorial, where you will produce your first car and learn the basic mechanics of production and sales. Additionally, there is one challenge mission, where you will need to use your wits to fulfill a special order for military vehicles. You start in the early 20th century with nothing but a few thousand dollars, which you will use to build your first manufacture. In time you will turn a simple workshop into an effective automatized factory. As you develop new car models and technologies, you will also have to manage your employees in the face of rising labor rights movements. Carefully build your brand’s reputation and promote your products to get ahead in the extremely competitive marketplace of the early automobile industry. Features Create a fully custom car factory. Build and optimize assembly lines for effective production. Manage several types of stats-driven employees. Promote products and set prices strategically. Develop new car models. Increase your factory’s popularity to draw more clients. Take part in industry events and face additional challenges. BUILD THE MOST ASTOUNDING AND FASTEST CARS! The beginning of the XX century brought us new opportunities. Show off the qualities of an excellent leader, as you will become the head of the car factory. It is up to you what will the future of the automotive industry look like. EXPAND YOUR BUSINESS! You will participate in the process of creating a car from the beginning to the end. Test manufactured cars as soon as they leave the production line. HIRE THE BEST OF THE BEST! Behind every car you create are people, more or less experienced. It is your responsibility to make the factory run at full capacity. Assign tasks accordingly to the skills of employees. AUTOMOTIVE INDUSTRY OF XX CENTURY AWAITS YOU! The development of the production line is the keystone. Start with individual stations to turn them later into a group of smaller, more-effective positions. Who knows, maybe in the future you will become a completely independent plant that produces even the smallest screw. STAY ON TOP In big business, it is easy to stay behind. Research new technologies and employ supervisors to ensure a top speed production.
row.short_description: Build a car factory in the beginning of XX century. Discover new cars and technologies. Manage employees. Make tons of money and stay on top. Car Manufacture: Prologue, being a shortened version of the full game, is a great way to try this automotive tycoon game.

row.name: Edge of War
row.detailed_description: Edge of War delivers an isometric CRPG experience where your choices carve a unique path through the Northlands inspired by laplands and Finnish Folklore. Engage in intricate grid-based combat, leveraging a deeply interactive environment to outmaneuver foes. In this world, every quest holds weight and significance, directly influencing your journey and the others around you. With semi-procedural world creation and emergent storytelling, each playthrough offers a distinct narrative and plenty of variety. Venture forth, but remember: mastering the environment is as crucial as mastering the blade. Engage in Tough & Tactical Combat Trials and tribulations await those who seek redemption in the Northlands. Assemble your squad and scout the wilds beyond Fort Turso. This tough turn-based CRPG will pit you against the dangers and the darkness that inhabit the North. Test your wit, wiles and will in a world inspired by Finnish Folklore and the Kalevala! A New Story Every Playthrough Procedurally-deployed hand-crafted quests along with reactive environments lead to a level emergent gameplay unlike any other, and ensures every playthrough is different. Your decisions affect the fate of the Northlands. Choose your squad, choose your skills, choose your allies. Make friends or enemies of the locals. Delve in dungeons and discover ancient artefacts. Fight tooth, nail and claw against the mighty beast of the wilds. Commune with the spirits and abide by their ways when traversing their realms. Or tackle indomitable constructs and collect their weird technology. Each element is taken into account and will shape not just your characters but the Northlands. The smallest decision can rally a faction to come to your aid, or seek your destruction. So be careful where you swing that blade, toss that fireball, or lay a kind word. How you live will determine how you die in Edge of War. Explore Finnish Folklore Your squad is tasked with exploring a region that has seen the corruption of a Compelled God, bears the scars of a warlord, and is marked by histories and peoples long forgotten. And yet, somehow people still eek out an existence amidst all these dangers. The Free Folk and the Barbarian Tribes call it home, as do the many spirits - all of them just waiting for a reason to kill you. Vaeki infuses every stone, every tree, every stream. It gives rise to life, it is present in death, and it is a gift of the gods. Ukko reigns above, Tuoni below. Their brethren are scattered. Yet all ignore you and your prayers. Such is the way of the North. Fort Turso is your home, your hub for adventures. From here you can journey to the borders of Pohjola or seek the river to Tuonela. Perhaps you will follow in the footsteps of Tapio or heap praise and prayers upon a shrine to Vetehain. Wherever you go Hiisi and other horrors are never far away.
row.short_description: Edge of War delivers an isometric, turn-based CRPG where the world reacts to you. All side quests are main quests, as every decision matters and impacts the fate of the Northlands. Explore and complete missions, but keep your heroes on their toes: the wilds do not forgive.
row.reviews: “The intriguing features of Edge of War make it a title worth exploring for CRPG enthusiasts and those looking for a fresh gaming experience.” Turn Based Lovers “Still, for this small, passionate team to bring Edge of War to Early Access simply because they believed in the project is a laudable achievement. It’s a unique game, with the Finnish folklore setting offering some novel twists on what’s possible with magic systems.” The Escapist
row.notes: There are light references to fantasy violence in the game.

row.name: SPOOKWARE: Watch Party
row.detailed_description: Before the school, before the cruise, before the restaurant. Experience the original version of SPOOKWARE, available for the first time on Steam. (For the uninitiated, SPOOKWARE is a blistering fast collection of handcrafted spooky games inspired by horror classics.) Watch Party is a completely FREE collection just in time for Halloween. We're going back to the past as we look towards the future of SPOOKWARE! SPOOKWARE: Watch Party collects: The original jam version of SPOOKWARE SPOOKWARE @ The Video Store from Dread X Collection 3 (previously paid!) SPOOKWARE: Prologue (FULL GAME DEMO) While you wait for the next installment of SPOOKWARE, settle in for: 40 spine-tingling, hair-raising, expectation-defying microgames. Witness the origins of our three favorite spooky boys: Lefti, Midi, and Righti. An experience that could cost upwards of 50 bones, but we're giving it away for FREE!
row.short_description: A collection of spooky microgames featuring fast-paced gameplay inspired by horror classics. Chop off legs, hurl hatchets, clash cards with Nosferatu, and many other ghoulish acts of terror! Features the original SPOOKWARE, SPOOKWARE @ the Video Store, and SPOOKWARE: Prologue for free!
row.notes: contains mild gore and cartoon violence

row.name: Xenture
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Xenture. In this game, our hero is tasked with riding their neighboring planet of dark magic. Take down the 6 dark magic sources and discover secrets to unfold inside the world. Good luck, our people are counting on you! Bullet Hell Madness Defeat swarms of enemies located around the world creating chaos. Earn different movement abilities in order to help navigate hectic fights and take down all 6 hives found on the planet. Loot Loads of Guns In Xenture, there are up to XXX guns ranging from all sorts of types and rarities. Kill enemies and hives as well as locate secret chests around the world to collect them all! Different guns allow for new styles of play when traversing the world and completing the story! Player Upgrades As you progress, you choose how your player becomes stronger. Upgrade your choice of Health, Shield, or Ammunition Stock upon levelling up. Also, this unlocks the potential for better enemy drops as well. Once the player reaches different points of the world, they will unlock several movement abilities such as sliding, double jumping, dashing, and jetpacking. About Us We appreciate you taking the time to check out our game. We understand it has its flaws but our team is very proud of what we were able to create in the time span given. We are a team of 7 students from the University of Utah, who created this game for a class project over the course of 13 weeks of summer. We learned a lot from the creation of this game and really hope you enjoy playing it!
row.short_description: Xenture is a short looter shooter game. Players need to destroy six hives located on the map then return to the spaceship to complete the game. We support multiple achievements for you to challenge.
row.notes: Includes cartoon violence.

row.name: 荣耀斗罗
row.detailed_description: 异能都市次世代幻想游戏《荣耀斗罗》震撼上线！赛特英雄破风来袭，觉醒变身，机甲降临！结契精灵，召唤神宠，追寻赛特神迹的秘密！魔法战斗，异能比拼，开启幻想冒险之旅！挑战魔王之巅，万人争霸激战到底！ 玩荣耀斗罗，加Outpop1102（VX），领20元现金！ 【开辟！次元世界】 异界冒险，魔幻战斗！未来都市异次元武器和座驾，多重变幻适应各类战斗环境，充满幻想的RPG手游带给你不一样的趣味比拼！ 【觉醒！机甲变身】 异能魔法，科学结合！转职觉醒与机甲合体，横扫万物。赛特英雄们，为守护世界而战！ 【追寻！赛特神迹】 结契精灵，召唤魔宠！陪伴英雄们的拯救世界之旅，唤醒封印元素力，追寻四大神器踪迹！发掘未来战甲战力翻倍，一击秒杀对手不是梦！ 【收割！爆仓福利】 未来座驾，酷炫超跑！轻松不肝，福利获取。开着超跑浪漫冒险，离线挂机就能赢取丰厚奖励！
row.short_description: 百变个性外形，多样养成策略，畅享热血战斗，体验超能者的都市传说！玩荣耀斗罗，加Outpop1102（VX），领20元现金！

row.name: Klaus Veen's Treason
row.detailed_description: At the start of each round, players must uncover the Don's killer by finding Clues . Delivering enough Clues to the Clue Processing Unit reveals a Traitor . Traitors conspire against the Innocents , Detective , and Doctor . Traitors win by eliminating all Innocents , while Innocents win by identifying and eliminating the Traitors . Classes: Slim Class: Quick but weak. Adrenaline - Boosts movement speed temporarily HP: 80 Movement Speed: +10% Damage Bonus: Medium and Shotgun ammo deal 15% more damage Medium Class: Balanced. Heal - Restores 25 HP HP: 100 Damage Bonus: Medium and Sniper ammo deal 7% more damage Heavy Class: Slow but strong. Shield - Reduces incoming damage by 30% temporarily HP: 110 Damage Bonus: Light ammo deals 10% more damage Role Abilities & Gadgets: Innocent : Find Clues to snuff out Traitors. Class Ability - Varies by class Clue Locator - Shows positions of all active clues Doctor Locator - Shows position of the Doctor Detective Locator - Shows position of the Detective Traitor : Eliminate all Innocents. Class Ability - Varies by class Radar - Reveals player locations Revival - Resurrects a dead player Bomb - Plants explosive traps Silenced Pistol - Fires silent shots Spiked Bat - Delivers lethal melee strikes Disguise - Conceals your identity Bear Trap - Immobilizes players Poison Dart - Slows targeted players Detective : Scan bodies to confirm deaths publicly. Heal - Restores 25 HP Shield - Reduces incoming damage Detective Radar - Reveals player locations Doctor Resuscitation - Revives an unconscious Doctor Scanner - Identifies the killer of a body, or the planter of a bomb Stunning Taser - Stuns and disarms a player Doctor : Resuscitate unconscious players. Range Heal - Heals you and nearby players Range Adrenaline - Boosts your and nearby players' movement speed temporarily Resuscitation - Resuscitate an unconscious player Body Radar - Locates unconscious players Health Station - Allows players to restore HP Zombie Traitor : Help Traitors. Adrenaline - Boosts movement speed temporarily Radar - Reveals player locations Bomb - Plants explosive traps Zombie Don : Help Innocents. Heal - Restores 25 HP Shield - Reduces incoming damage Adrenaline - Boosts movement speed temporarily Clue Processing Unit (C.P.U.): At the start of each round, the Don's body appears. When a player discovers it, Clues spawn across the map for players to collect. Delivering enough Clues to the C.P.U. reveals a Traitor . Beware: Traitors can sabotage the C.P.U. by shutting off its power supply! Join our Discord community! Treason is a hobby project with a small but active and friendly community. Use the Discord server to look for players, if the game servers are empty.
row.short_description: Treason is a 3-16 player party shooter of teamwork and betrayal, set among Italian mobsters. Use proximity voice chat, unique abilities/gadgets, and strategy to prove your innocence or deceive others.
row.reviews: “Treason is great with friends! Gameplay is solid. 9/10” 8.8 – Metacritic (User score)
row.notes: Includes blood and violence.

row.name: Book Hunter
row.detailed_description: In this third person stealth and adventure game you'll guide ArgentoBOT to explore an abandoned library to collect the treasures which are hiding inside of it. With more than 100 collectibles and many enemies crawling in the shadows, the experience of Book Hunter waves from adventure to stealth, from strategy to horror, but never abuses violence or fear as primary mechanics. ArgentoBOT units are mechanical scouts which objective is to travel across the universe and collect relics of the ancient human civilization . As they are unarmed, they have to use what they find on the spot to explore the ruins and collecting the survived artworks: books are the most important objects , but even paintings and music are of deep archeological interest. The player can choose between confronting directly with the enemies or studying their behavior to bypass them. The main objective is to collect the 30 books scattered in the map. All the secondary collectibles belongs to the Public Domain as one of the major purpose of Book Hunter is the transmission of freedom-culture in addition to entertaining. Books in the game are provided as a promotional service for the Italian publisher Argentodorato Editore .
row.short_description: In this stealth adventure game you'll guide ArgentoBOT through an ancient library to find the hidden treasures resting inside of it. Survive the dangers crawling in the shadows, use objects to stun or distract your enemies end use strategically the lights to hide from threats.

row.name: NRGeditor
row.detailed_description: Modular Featherlight Framework Create Epic Visual Moments! Using a unique modular approach under the hood; only what you need is part of your App. No dependencies or external packages are required. NRG runs at full speed 100% natively on all supported platforms and produces output at a fraction of the size of any other solution out there! An Engine to Create Engines NRG provides you specialized tools to gain direct access to low levels APIs through a thin comprehensive abstraction layer for you to start building on. Gain some serious re-usable skills by learning how to build from scratch state-of-the-art Games and Interactive Apps. Designed to be Customizable Develop your Handbuilt 3D Engine with NRG and achieve better performance than any other all-in-one solutions out there. Written in pure C our Non-Linear Programmable Core can be accessed via Lua or directly in pure C/C++ and produce lightweight, lightning-fast native stand-alone executables. Programmable Rendering Pipeline Use NRG to develop your very own Customized Rendering Graphics Engine tuned precisely for your project. Achieve better performance than the competition by creating your GPU rendering pipeline tailored specifically for your application's need and optimized for your targeted platforms. Build From the Ground Up Built for rapid prototyping and to handle projects of any size, with NRG you can develop, code, build, profile and debug your App. on one or multiple platforms simultaneously in realtime. Once you App. ready you can publish it as a native C/C++ standalone executable or as an add-on for another external project. Xena: Warrior Princess - Full Project (Source Code and Assets): This mini game was created from scratch (renderer included) in 2 weeks by one programmer and one artist for the Game Jolt Together Jam using NRG as a development platform. NRGstation Realtime Pathtracing DEMO - Full Project (Source Code and Assets): NRGshowroom DEMO - Full Project (Source Code and Assets): MicroBots - Full Project + Online Learning Sessions: MicroLand - Full Project + Online Learning Sessions: MicroKart - Full Project + Online Learning Sessions:
row.short_description: NRG - Realtime Application Development Environment

row.name: Kismet Tapestry
row.detailed_description: In this first-person, 2.5D singleplayer pixel-graphic turn based RPG set in the distant future, the player controls various members of the crew of the Federation of Frontier Colonies' Dirac Space Station, as an intergalactic conspiracy entangles its trusted captain. This game is mainly a story-rich Dungeon-crawler style RPG with cinematic cutscenes and sci-fi themes.
row.short_description: A first-person, 2.5D singleplayer RPG set in space in the distant future, the player controls various members of the crew of the Federation of Frontier Colonies' Dirac Space Station as an intergalactic conspiracy unfolds.
row.notes: brief nudity

row.name: Spirits of Carter Mansion
row.detailed_description: Oh no! You've just kicked your favourite ball into the gigantic abandoned manor across the street! In a moment of bravery you venture inside to retrieve, but slowly begin to regret it. Journey around the house, uncovering its twisted halls, and sinister secrets whilst trying to escape with your beloved prize! Navigate each room of the house with your eyes open and watch your bravery diminish, or close your eyes and be safe, but lost wandering around the expansive corridors of the estate. Find yourself unlocking great secrets to the haunted house's past to help you navigate through safely! -Navigate using a classic North, East, South, West system akin to Zork -Explore several room with unique art as you bravely peek through your fingers; -Or instead close your eyes to wander around lost, but safely! -Uncover parts of the history of the Carter Mansion as you explore -Unlock different tool to help you navigate the house, including a nameable Cat companion that warns you of danger! -Lots of little secrets to discover as you try and complete all of the diary pages and unlock all the achievements!
row.short_description: Oh no! You've just kicked your favourite ball into the gigantic abandoned manor across the street! In a moment of bravery you venture inside to retrieve and journey around the house, uncovering its twisted halls, and sinister secrets whilst trying to escape with your beloved prize!

row.name: Crawlspace
row.detailed_description: You saw an Ad about someone needing help with an odd job, retrieving his daughters missing dolls. Sounding like easy cash, you leave a message telling him you are interested. but as the nights progress, you realize why nobody else wanted to take this job. ---- Main Objective - Collect and return each missing doll from the crawlspace over 5 nights using a unique VR crawling mechanic. Figure out how to stay safe from each doll with different attacks. Relax at your home and enjoy some TV. This game includes jumpscares. VR Only
row.short_description: You've been tasked with crawling into a crawlspace to retrieve some dolls. what could go wrong? Made exclusively for VR

row.name: Simkea
row.detailed_description: Ein Online-Rollenspiel im Retro-Look mit weitverzweigtem, interaktivem Crafting-System und Wirtschaftssimulation. Sammle, handle und produziere, um dich vom Apfelernter zum Marktstandbesitzer hochzuarbeiten. Quests und Events bieten Abwechslung und die Chance auf seltene Spezialitems (ohne direkte Auswirkungen auf den Spielfluss). Es gibt keine Timer oder zeitlichen Zwänge, sodass du in deinem eigenen Rhythmus spielen kannst. Community Wichtigstes Feature des Spiels ist die freundliche, hilfsbereite und fast immer positive Community, die im und um das Spiel zusammenhält und viel auf die Beine stellt. Auch der Entwickler steht in ständigem Kontakt mit den Spielern und nimmt Ideen, Vorschläge und Kritik auf. Regelmäßige Streams zu Neuigkeiten und Entwicklung sowie RL-Treffen runden das Gemeinschaftserlebnis ab. Unzählige Items fürs Crafting, Housing und Sammeln Entdecke stimmungsvolle Orte und erlebe die Welt in Simkea
row.short_description: Ein Online-Rollenspiel mit umfangreichem Crafting- und Wirtschaftssystem. Sammle, handle und produziere oder erledige Quests und Event-Aufgaben. Die herzliche Community und der direkte Draht zum Entwickler machen das Spiel zu etwas Besonderem.

row.name: Stella's Spikey Dream
row.detailed_description: A relaxing casual game about a little girl, her big stick and their adventure to collect strange cards in a cave. This is a 2D action platformer game. The player needs to venture through a cave filled with dangerous spikes, and will be navigating through the levels to reach a mysterious enemy at the end. The core gameplay is platforming, the player will be utilising their ability to double jump in order to jump to and from multiple platforms. Timing is important as one wrong move and result in the player falling to their death. Some of the environment can be destroyed by attacking them with the stick carried by the player, maybe there will be interesting finds.
row.short_description: Little girl, her stick and an adventure in a 2D card collecting action platformer!

row.name: Ajedrez una tarde de Otoño
row.detailed_description: Ajedrez una tarde de Otoño is a little chess simulator game, a young lady in a wheelchair plays against a man with a cowboy hat. Who will win? game only avaible in spanish from latinamerica
row.short_description: chess simulator game

row.name: No Crooks On Christmas
row.detailed_description: ONE SNOWY, MAGICAL CHRISTMAS EVE... Your house is invaded by crooks! In this fast-paced tower defense game, you must defend the Christmas tree from a relentless onslaught of enemies. They're here to steal your presents, and they're not holding anything back. Spend star points to create Towers to defend your house. There are three Special Abilities you can use: the Bomb, the Water Bucket, and the Toilet. These abilities unlock as you progress through the different levels. The flaming presents will appear if the Christmas tree takes too much damage. The more presents you have active, the more damage over time your tree will take. Battle your way through ten different levels, then try your hand at Survival Mode! How long can you last against these Christmas crooks? * This was my first completed project as a game development student. * FEATURES: * Play through 10 different levels and a Survival Mode * Develop different strategies for Tower placement * Douse the fires with the Water Bucket when the presents are ablaze * Eliminate enemies quickly with the Bomb and Toilet abilities * Fun and quirky holiday theme CONTROLS: * Space Bar: Move between the different rooms of the house * Left Mouse Button: Click to place Towers and use Special Abilities
row.short_description: No Crooks on Christmas is a tower defense game with a fun holiday theme. Defend your house against a relentless onslaught of crooks and save Christmas!

row.name: Soma Union
row.detailed_description: We spirits are curious things, Zero. We all have a purpose to fulfill, and each of us represents something. And I hope you can figure out what you represent, too. Guess you can figure that out while you're off putting the whole world back together. Soma Union is a galaxy-spanning adventure that returns to the world of Soma! ...or so it would, if your planet had not been destroyed in a great calamity. As you roam through the cosmos to find the missing fragments of your home world, you'll meet a colorful cast of characters and make important choices that may not be as clear as they seem. Soma Union is an SNES-styled RPG that aims to celebrate the classics (and the not-so-classics because they deserve love, too). As you experience this space-faring story, you'll explore vast dungeons, interact with strange characters, fight riveting turn-based battles and discover the fate of a shattered land! Combat is all about synergy and supporting one another! The Role System changes your characters' roles in battle: Fight your enemies with the damage-dealing Power role, or enhance other party members' abilities with the Support role! By utilizing roles to your advantage, you'll be able to achieve great effects that a single party member can't accomplish alone! Embark on a galaxy-spanning quest to put your home world back together again, because this planet can't seem to catch a break, apparently. Unleash powerful Spirit abilities regardless of your current role to turn the tide of battle! Collect valuable Power Gems to skip enemy encounters with the push of a button... or tough it out and exchange them for rare prizes! Fully custom visuals. And a stellar soundtrack by SpecialAgentApe 10+ hours of good ol' son-of-a-gun RPG gameplay. Funny jokes. The heehees and the hawhaws.
row.short_description: Having fallen to a great calamity a second time, it's up to Zero and their friends to put Soma back together! What is on your horizon is for you to decide...

row.name: Porcelana
row.detailed_description: Join our Discord! About the Game Synopsis Porcelana ( Porcelain ) is a story of a girl who is perceived to be perfect by society but is actually more normal than others may think. This shows a reflection of reality where people wear masks to hide the darkness in their hearts. Although the story itself was written years back, we are wanting to share it with others in a new way through a visual novel format. We hope that this emotional story will touch your heart and be one that you remember. If you could change the past, would you? Isabella, your classmate, is someone you were never close to but someone you certainly noticed. One day however, you notice that Isabella stopped coming to class. You start to discover how important you were to her despite never even having a conversation with her before. She has left you notes in a particular way that takes you on a journey where you discover her past and meet the people who were important in her life. Be careful with what choices you make as they can impact the events and direction of the story. Isabella She was so pretty, with her beauty being indescribable. Her flawless smile was like staring at the clouds. She was the correct path among thousands of wrongs. She was always herself, not perfect, but the image of perfection. She was someone that you looked up to the most. Despite always seeming so delighted and happy though, you already realize just how miserable she was, even to the point where she was contemplating cutting ties to life and choosing death as her final escape. Camil You met Camil because Isabella left her a note too. You don't know too much about her just the fact that she is your classmate too. Maybe she has some beauty hidden under those cap and glasses. Dallen She is Caroline's mom. Dallen's work usually puts her at risk and that is why her greatest fear is that one day something could happen to her leaving her daughter alone. She is a loving mother and a very smart woman. Caroline She's the reflection of the purest innocence. She is a happy child even though she hasn't lived a perfect life, because she has lived hard moments in her short life. She has a fantastic imagination, which often results in her losing herself in her own dreams.
row.short_description: Isabella, your classmate, is someone you were never close to but someone you certainly noticed. One day however, you notice that Isabella stopped coming to class. You start to discover how important you were to her despite never even having a conversation with her before.
row.reviews: “Although this may not mean much since it's only January but this is my favourite game so far this year and I'm absolutely satisfied as a Kickstarter backer.” Kuratsu “It is more than just a romance game, the character captivates you and makes you wonder about a bunch of the actual world, like your fears and also puts you to reflect about life and youth.” Wei “The pastel UI and the music box make a very good job of giving a false sense of security to the player; and even though I knew what was in store for me, 'that' scene still really hit me.” HippoTheCat
row.notes: This game contains mature themes such as non-explicit but suggestive sexual acts, partial nudes, obscene language, rudeness language, also this game involves topics that customers may have a sensitivity to, and would like to be aware of, such as sexual assault/non-consensual sex, drug/alcohol abuse, self-harm and suicide.

row.name: Evil's Den: Forsaken Dungeon
row.detailed_description: Check these About the Game Evil's Den is a rogue-lite dungeon crawler featuring procedurally generated levels where you will battle through hordes of monsters to close a portal to Hell opened in the village's church. Help Redlovo villagers The local priest, in his stupidity, made a human sacrifice on the altar. He did not expect that this act of evil would open a portal to the world of demons. Put an end to the waves of monsters coming out of the portal, help the inhabitants of the village of Redlovo. The villagers are afraid for their lives and their loved ones, and the kingdom of Pomerania is also in danger,if you do not stop the enemies by closing the portal, they can threaten the entire continent. Rise from the dead Thanks to the help of mages, you are almost immortal. If something gets in your way and you fall, they will resurrect you by magic in the city. All hope is in you! Try, die, resurrect, repeat. New challenge, new dungeons! Dungeons are procedurally generated meaning you'll never play the same level twice, it builds up a new challenge every time you enter the den of evil. Each run will be slightly different, when entering the portal, expect a new challenge. Loot! One-handed and two-handed swords, axes, katanas, shields, bows and even new spells. All of this is waiting for you in the dungeons, dear adventurer. Get the blueprint and make a new weapon in the city to help you on your next run! Grow strong You can use the acquired gold to rearm before the next attempt to defeat the lord of the Evil’s Den. Thanks to this, his filthy minions will cause you less trouble and you will be closer to your goal. The mages will teach you new spells and the blacksmith will make a weapon according to the crafting recipes you provided. To the battle, become a legend!
row.short_description: Evil's Den: Forsaken Dungeon is a rogue-lite dungeon crawler featuring procedurally generated levels where you will battle through hordes of monsters to close portal to Hell, opened in the villages church.

row.name: Eldritch Lands: The Witch Queen's Eternal War
row.detailed_description: Eldritch Lands: The Witch Queen's Eternal War is a dark fantasy strategy game in which you play as the titular Witch Queen in her struggle against the endless undead horde. In this bleak world where all the gods have either been killed or abandoned their people, when the dead rise due to the sudden appearance of a Necromancer known only as the Necroshroom Queen, it’s up to the Witch Queen to defend her Kingdom. As normal humans only add to the undead army when they die, the Witch Queen diverted all her resources into creating an army of fake people, known as a Homunculi, to serve as an unending fodder to hold the dead at bay. Unlock, Upgrade and Get to Know Your Units Discover up to 12 different units that you can use in battle. Each with different ups and downs in combat, you can customize your team to better fit your playstyle. Prefer slow moving but heavy hitting units? Or quick and long ranged? Build the team that best suits your needs. Each unit is also their own individual character, and the more you upgrade a unit the more conversations you unlock as well. Get to know each unit and find out their outlook on the war, their life or what it means to be just a copy of a copy of the memories of someone long dead. Farm Resources and Read Lore During battle, you can gain seeds that grow into fruits and plants that are highly concentrated in essence, the currency that all of the Witch Queen’s magic relies on. Plant those seeds and harvest them after they grow for a great boost in essence. You can also read through the lore of the world to gain more knowledge of what happened before and why the world is in such disarray, and a new entry is added with each new enemy and item you encounter throughout your playthrough.
row.short_description: Dive into a dark fantasy world and fight against the endless undead horde. Unlock, upgrade and deploy units in a simple to understand yet engaging strategy gameplay loop. Grow plants that grant exp bonuses and converse with each unit to learn more about their character and backstory.

row.name: Fantasteroids
row.detailed_description: Enjoy a refreshing arcade-like blast to the past with Fantasteroids. A game with a simple concept, which is easy to pick up but hard to master. You will need incredible precision, an unblinking eye to watch for hazards, and a stamina to match a marathon runner's. Features Fast-paced gameplay A variety of different modes and experiences for you to choose from Over 20 different characters and skins to unlock Steam leaderboards so you can play and compete with people around the world!
row.short_description: Fast-paced gameplay, rainbow colours and snappy animations all come together to give you a retro arcade-feel game with renewed graphics and avatars. There's a variety of different modes for you to choose from, and different skins to unlock and leaderboards for you to show off to your friends!

row.name: Phantom-OS
row.detailed_description: Phantom-OS is a physics-infused strategic hacking simulator where you will put your skills and wits to the test. You play as Kyle Hastings, a capable programmer with a knack for hacking. Having dropped out of college to focus on your newfound passion, you now live a double life: a freelancer by day and a gray hat hacker by night. But little does Kyle know, his life is about to take a major turn when he installs a strange operating system: Phantom OS. UNRESTRICTED ACCESS (NO SCRIPTED LIMITATIONS) A core philosophy of ours is a “no scripted” approach to player actions. You can (eventually, given your skill as a hacker) gain full control over every device in your network, delete, break (as in physically, with a hammer) any computer you can get your hands on. WINDOW-BASED OPERATING SYSTEM A familiar concept to almost everyone, your computer behaves like - what else? A real computer. Run programs, create, move, and delete files organically, and given the special arsenal of tools at your disposal, infiltrate into other machines to steal data, brick devices, or spy on your targets. FULLY SIMULATED NETWORKS Every computer, from those you target to the ones you own, are fully featured internet-connected devices, able to communicate and transfer files between one another. This happens via in-world routers and relays making up the network. PHYSICS BASED ENVIRONMENT Your computers, like your environment, are real in-world objects. You can move, interact with, and modify them for your own needs. Make your hacker den your own. EMERGENT GAMEPLAY The way you tackle missions depends on your approach. Go in person and attempt to get physical access to your target. Remotely from your secured network Social engineering FACTIONS As you make a name for yourself, you will discover that you are not alone. Multiple other hacker groups will notice your actions and either take a liking for it or attempt to shut it down. Balance your influence with social opinion on your actions, maintaining a delicate balance to not risk detection. LIVE YOUR LIFE The world waits for no one, not even you. Opportunities come and go and it's your job to make the most of them. The game features a full day/night cycle with events and opportunities becoming available during certain times of day, so plan and manage your personal life and schedule accordingly. Your surroundings affect you as much as you can affect them. Learn your town and its networks, opportunities, and exploit them to achieve your goals - be it fame, money, or connections. BEYOND/HOPEFUL Given the early-access state of the game and our very small team (2), we plan to continue working towards achieving our final vision for the game, past the stuff mentioned above. This will include: MILESTONE 1 Procedurally generated hacking opportunities (events, scheduled PC uptime, rival hackers' actions, etc.) Currency, inventory management, upgrade systems Leaving the apartment - outside city content: locations and activities MILESTONE 2 Multiplayer V1 (hacking only - players can help each other from their apartments) Adding roleplay elements (NPC interactions) Game balancing Modding support MILESTONE 3 Expanding roleplay elements (reputation system, branching story) Diversification of missions, quality of life Improvements More content (larger city, more missions) Multiplayer V2 (fully featured coop and group missions)

row.name: PlanetDrop - A Tiny Space Adventure
row.detailed_description: PlanetDrop - A Tiny Space Adventure is a computer game where you command a spaceship in an orbit of a planet. Your primary task is to capture 'drop zones' with your shuttles and commandos. You rely on stealth, agility and speed, rather than on firepower. Game mechanics and features The mechanics are described in their best details on the official game website, but here are some of the most distinguished: - the ships feel like in real space - no gravity, inertia - planets have atmosphere - ship might get damaged by it - full 3d movement freedom - patience, some tactical thinking and battlefield observation is needed - automatic weaponry, countermeasures - armor and shield for most of the ships - ship subsystems, repairs - story progression, described in briefings before every mission - briefing hints and in-game tooltips to act as tutorial and help the player - friendly, neutral, enemy ships - small random events Ship/inventory management There is a basic inventory management with option to replenish it at certain conditions - when approaching space station or calling for support. The ship uses fuel and life-support items. Overall feeling Inspired by 'The Expanse' series, the set is (trying) staying 'close-to-real-world' physics and limitations, where space is vast, empty and dangerous, the humans are vulnerable, sustained entirely by their craft. The technological level, with small exceptions, is close to our near-future one. The short background story can be found on 'the set' subpage on the website. Game Length: The game is about 2-10 hours long, includes 6 single-player missions. The difficulty level is moderate. Creation This is an independent, non-commercial, non-profit project, driven by the pure passion for games, the curiosity how they are made and function, the admiration of the ingenuity it takes to create one, the huge challenge and a long-lasting dream. The game is created in the span of 10 months - from January 2021 to October 2021, by a single man with no experience in the field whatsoever.

row.detailed_description: A FIRST EVER VR ASYMMETRICAL HORROR GAME: NEW: Play with A.I. bots! In order to ensure anyone can play with a full lobby and experience the full game at any time, we are proud to announce that after a lot of hard work we have added A.I. bots After Dark VR is the first VR online co-op survival horror where you play as either a Hunter on the hunt to strike down your next victim or as Survivors working together to stay alive and escape. 6 Hunters in 6 Maps are Available Now with many more to come! - Immersive VR Horror Experience - High Quality Maps - In-Game Chat - A.I. Bots Objective for the Hunter is to use brute force striking down the Survivors locking them away in a Cage so they can't escape. Objective for Survivors is to turn on 4 Fuse Boxes so the Exit Gate powers on allowing them out of the area they're trapped in with the Hunter. Fuse Boxes are located all around the Map. Survivors need to find a Fuse Box and turn all levers from OFF to ON then power on with Handle. If done incorrectly, the levers will reset. Light will switch from Red to Green once powered on. Note: The Hunter can interact with the Fuse Boxes and reset progress made. Once Survivors power on 4 Fuse Boxes they can escape through the Exit Gate and win. When the Hunter strikes down a Survivor the Survivor enters Spectate Mode and their body spawns in a Cage somewhere in the Map. Survivors can free teammates by pulling the lever beside the Cage the Survivor is trapped in. The Hunter must strike down all Survivors to win. Suburbs Prison Hangar Farm Police Station NEW Highschool MORE COMING SOON (2022) 4 friends are renting a house near a Music Festival for a weekend getaway where there just so happens to be a ruthless Hunter on the loose. After trying to leave, they quickly realize the Hunter has turned off the exit's power, leaving them trapped until they figure out how to power on their escape! row.name: SPY RUMBLE
row.detailed_description: Update Notes 2023/04/22 New item 'Killer Badge' and third camp 'Killer'. 2023/02/21 New map 'Secret Lab' has been implemented. 2022/08/27 New mode 'Hunting' was implemented 2022/08/27 Zombie Pirates Shima skin was implemented 2022/07/03 Text chat feature implemented 2022/06/25 Open Room Match function implemented About the Game Welcome to the crazy battle royale imposter stage! Among the agents gathered on this stage, you will find a spy who is plotting to assassinate you. If you find a spy, you must either put a lead ball from your gun in his head or persuade the others to expel him. Of course, be aware that your own back is always being watched. If you're just scared, you're easy prey! If you don't want to get yourself killed, you can have fun killing the spies that have slipped through the cracks! Number of players: 4-8 This game is an identity concealment style, in which the player is divided into two cliques, the agent team and the spy team, and take action to achieve the respective victory conditions. Available for multiple players with voice chat function in-game. (Using voice chat is recommended). -Agents-. The agents are imposed to transfer the coins they have earned, fill up the helicopter with fuel and escape, or find and get rid of the spies who are hiding in the team. If you see anyone suspicious, call a meeting! -Spies- The mission of the spies is to eliminate all the agents. To achieve this, pretending to be an agent, obtain and use the items and weapons from the spy armoury or use the spy gadgets that you equip with you for the mission. Spy gadgets are secret weapons dedicated for spies that can be equipped in for the mission. You can use it as many times as you want by purchasing it in the store. Transceiver can be purchased at the store, that can host a meeting to start discussion. You can get a player to expulsion at the meeting, by voting someone you think is suspicious. One player, one vote. Third camp -Killer- Agents can change into the third camp Killer by meeting certain conditions and purchasing the “Killer Badge”, an item that becomes available in the store. The Killer's goal is to eliminate all players except himself, and once he becomes a Killer, he will be able to use the Spy Shop. Hunting Mode Hunting Mode is a more combat-oriented mode than the regular game mode. The victory condition is quite simple: victory is achieved by annihilating the enemy camp! Spies have fewer people and can use exclusive weapons and skills. Agents win not only by defeating their opponents, but also by escaping from the helicopter by transferring coins. Voice chat is available for all allied teams regardless of distance, so you can work together to hunt down the enemy team!
