row.name: Powder
row.detailed_description: From Gameplay Recordings & Long Streams to Viral Clips Get short-form videos from your gameplay recordings & streams in a few clicks. Powder is a Windows app that empowers gamers, content creators, and video editors to transform lengthy gameplay recordings and streams into a wealth of impactful social media clips with ease. It's short-form content creation for gamers made swift and simple. Just a few clicks to repurpose long videos into short-form content—and spend more time with the community who supports them. KEY POINTS Powder is now free for gamers and enthusiast content creators! Record your gameplay sessions and audio using Powder’s native screen recorder. Quickly transform long streams (Twitch, YouTube, Kick) or video files into shareable, social-ready clips in a few clicks. Powder AI identifies creators' best in-stream moments —from emotionally charged moments with laughter and rage, to spikes in community chat activity, to the game-winning knock-downs, headshots, and goals. Powder also has CTRL+F for short-form video. Powder transcribes every word spoken during a stream and intelligently categorizes the content, making it easy for creators to search and find specific moments, and clip those as short videos, based on keywords or topics. Automatic and manual montages stitch clips together into shareable compilations with just a few clicks. Optimized short videos , in horizontal or vertical format, for TikTok, Twitter, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and more. Saves gamers, creators, and video editors 10+ hours per week .
row.short_description: From Gameplay Recordings & Long Streams to Viral Clips. Get short-form videos from your gameplay recordings & streams in a few clicks.

row.name: 超将棋
row.detailed_description: はじめに 「ゲームはもっと、シンプルでいい。」 この理念のもと、物理演算と将棋を掛け合わせた超将棋は制作されました。 あなたが友人や世界の強敵たちと切磋琢磨しながら、この懐かしい、それでいて 未知のボードゲームを楽しんで頂ければそれ以上の喜びはありません。 ゲームのルール 　このゲームでは世界中のプレイヤーと戦うことができる対戦モードと、1人で遊ぶ 詰将棋モードの二つが用意されています。 　対戦モードでは、互いのプレイヤーは自分の駒を物理的に動かすことができ、相手の 王将を盤外に落とせば勝ちとなります。ここでいう「物理的に動かす」というのは、 駒をデコピンで吹っ飛ばす感覚に近いです。 　詰将棋モードは、それぞれの課題において指定された手数内で 全ての 敵の駒を 落とすことが目的のゲームです。課題によっては、王以外を落としてしまうと失格となる ものもあります。
row.short_description: 「ゲームはもっと、シンプルでいい。」 この理念のもと、物理演算と将棋を掛け合わせた超将棋は制作されました。 あなたが友人や世界の強敵たちと切磋琢磨しながら、この懐かしい、それでいて 未知のボードゲームを楽しんで頂ければそれ以上の喜びはありません。

row.name: SOLAR CAGE
row.detailed_description: “SOLAR CAGE” is a challenging parkour-shooter that takes place in the distant future, where a majority of humanity has been converted into mechanical monstrosities. They’ve built a Dyson sphere surrounding the Sun, using its energy to fuel their highly inefficient lifestyle. Using something known as the CATALYST, their consciousness exists as a copy of their original brain within these bodies. You play as JANITOR-2828, a designated cleaning robot who is suddenly contacted by an unknown entity. Your abilities are upgraded from cleaning to being able to jump, wall run, and slide with ease. It was even nice enough to give you a signature rail gun. All of these achieve a simple task: BLOW UP THE SUN. RUN. SHOOT. REPEAT. Pull off crazy acrobatics as you run, slide, and jump around each area in the facility. One bullet, one chance. If you miss, you'll have to beat down robotic combatants to reload your gun. Make every shot count. Chain your parkour and combat skills together to pull off epic, precisely timed traversal combos! HELLO WORLD Shoot and jump your way through 9 dystopian levels that never fail to test your timing, accuracy, and willpower. Experience new mechanics as you get closer to the Sun, from gravity flipping to challenge arenas! Discover a multitude of paths in each level to figure out the quickest routes for speedruns. PREPARE TO DIE No checkpoints, no easy mode, no excuses. A hero's journey is never that simple. Master each level to the point where you know every shot, wall run, and leap of faith like the back of your hand. Then, impress your friends with perfect runs! Do what it takes to BLOW UP THE SUN!
row.short_description: You have one job: BLOW UP THE SUN. A game perfect for parkour/shooter fans, speedrunners, and those looking for an extra challenging experience!

row.name: Endless Battlefield
row.detailed_description: Discover and experience FPS battles in an endless battlefield world! FPS includes 6 modes: Conquer, Capture the Flag, Sprint, Team Deathmatch, Deathmatch and Confirmed Kill. The following is the content of subsequent development in the future, and will be marked: The planet metaworld mode is rich in content to meet the needs of different players. The game supports intensive FPS/TPS, allowing competitive players to enjoy the experience of galloping on the battlefield and conquering military points. Metaverse also creates a stress-free and immersive environment for casual players, allowing them to harvest, mine, wood, fish, hunt, and craft items. In order to create a rich and interesting meta-world, EB has also introduced a unique alliance system, construction system, home system and trading system. The official version will cover the complete FPS/TPS combat content. Planets metaverse content will be accessible through the DLC version.
row.short_description: Endless Battlefield is a competitive multiplayer online FPS game. It gives players the capacity to control various weapons and vehicles in the game.The FPS covers 6 modes: Conquest, Capture the Flag, Rush, Team Deathmatch, Deathmatch and Kill Confirmed.

row.name: Lawnarchy
row.short_description: A card game for gardening lunatics: manicure your lawn, trim your hedges – and steam roll over your neighbors' flowers!

row.name: 戦国の木こり
row.detailed_description: 'War era Lumberjack' is a mini-game in the process of making a simulation game during the Warring States period in Japan. This is a game in which you have a lumberjack cut down trees and compete for how much wood you can collect within a certain period of time. Players can only order which trees to cut.
row.short_description: 'War era Lumberjack' is a mini-game in the process of making a simulation game during the Warring States period in Japan.

row.name: Doge Dimensions
row.detailed_description: Explore The Galaxy: Take advantage of Doge’s robust movement options to explore 3 far-off planets, and take on unique challenges Gooba's Gambit Fight hoards of Gooba’s in a grueling gauntlet to the death. Collect their eyeballs and be wary of their Slime Slinging Slashes Coin Chase Collect as many coins as possible while navigating a forest of crystals and evading perilous sandstorms Hidden Hams Look through every crack and crevice as you explore the sacred Hidden Ham Hills to satisfy your hungry Doge.
row.short_description: Blast through the Doge Dimensions and explore the multiverse in this open world adventure. Fly, dash, and defy gravity as you discover unknown terrain and take on a variety of challenges.

row.name: Lost Light
row.detailed_description: Join our Discord! About the Game Easy to play! Both FPP and TPP are here for you to choose from. Realistic warfare survival Factories, harbors, forests...... these once familiar sights have been desecrated by the wrath of the apocalypse. Never neglect small details on the battlefield or there will be fatal consequences. You must know your weapons and know your equipment, explore every corner of the battlefield, learn to effectively deal with hunger and pain, and make tactical plans...... Complete survivors' commissions, scavenge for supplies, and hone your skills to survive the exclusion zone. Authentic Firearm Customization From structures to textures, the firearms in the game are meticulously recreated to provide players with the most realistic firearms experience. Each firearm supports up to 12 modifiable parts and hundreds of components to choose from. It's time to optimize your loadout from hundreds of possibilities. Of course, the system will also provide several recommended loadouts for Quick Equip. All About Tactics In Lost Light, violence is not always the answer—as long as you can find the evacuation point, you can make it out alive. You may choose to go armed to the teeth, wreaking havoc and reaping the loots, or you may choose to be a minimalist, scavenging your way to a small fortune. But remember, if you die in combat, you lose everything—the loots are not yours until you make it out alive! Map Out Before Moving Out Prepare yourself for battle in your shelter. Not only do you need to boost your body energy and stay in good shape, but more importantly, you have to customize and build your own loadout. But be careful with the gear you choose, because the battle begins when you start to equip yourself. Diversified Social Interaction Unlike conventional competitive survival games, Lost Light allows you to choose partnership over being a lone wolf. You may decide to team up with a spared enemy or commission other players to rescue you after you're knocked out—endless possibilities await! Profit Off Free-trade After the evacuation, you retreat deep within the abandoned subway tunnels where you stash your loot and establish a foothold. After upgrading it to a full-fledged base of operations, you can set up shop and trade within Lost Light's player-driven economy. Sell your surplus and buy what's in need—Trade wisely and your chance of survival increases! Cross-Platform Play PC gamers can now feel the exhilaration of battle. Players on mobile devices and PC will be able to chat with one another for a cross-platform gaming experience. Form parties across the different platforms to complete more challenges and achieve the impossible!
row.short_description: Join the 'Firefly' task force and unveil the sinister plot behind the exclusion zone in the world of Lost Light. You could either scavenge for supplies or go out with guns blazing and plunder. Survive the brutal domain where danger lurks in every corner!

row.name: Live Adventure
row.detailed_description: Live Adventure is a 2nd person adventure game that follows the expedition of a unique sibling duo of young explorers wannabes. The brother, Lence, holds the game camera, and the sister, Reel, is filmed by that same camera. The adventure starts at the launch of STEVE, the camera of Lence. After the disappearance of their parents, those siblings throw themselves on a great adventure to find them back. Working together, on the track of a lost civilization, they will discover wonderful places and uncover mysterious ruins. As a player, you have constant control over these two characters. You will have to use their abilities in synergy to explore and solve puzzles in the lost ruins of a lush forest. Experience a completely new way of controlling two characters with a gamepad from the point of view of a camera hold by one of them. You will be able to really play as a duo! Follow the story of Lence and Reel, on an expedition to find their missing parents. Follow them in their journey full of mysteries, adventures, and emotions. Lence and Reel will travel through many colorful extraordinary places, discover an uncharted forest full of exotic vegetation and enigmatic ruins. During their expedition, Lence and Reel will discover many ruins and old mechanisms that they will have to understand to solve the mysteries of a legendary civilization and find their parents.
row.short_description: Throw yourself into an exciting adventure! Live Adventure is a 2nd person game where you follow the journey of two young explorers, Lence and Reel in search of their parents. Solve the mysteries of a lost civilization while exploring a lush forest littered with mysterious ruins.

row.detailed_description: Story 世界各大博物館與私人館藏自2079年開始傳出陸續失蹤珍貴藏品的報告，這些藏品各自具有不同的神秘力量。2080年臺灣文學館失竊了一副具有改變歷史力量的文物：劉吶鷗的麻將牌，國際刑警高度懷疑這是國際恐怖組織RISS所策動的行為。 該組織宣稱擁有「時空回溯」的技術，有高度證據指出RISS打算在二戰發生前夕，派出特務使用麻將，藉以扭轉二次大戰最終結果。玩家將扮演行動代號「獵殺1940」的國際特務，潛入RISS基地啟動時光機回到過去，尋回麻將同時將歷史導入正軌，以阻止RISS狂妄的野心。 Gameplay 本遊戲以日治時期的小說家、影人劉吶鷗生平為故事文本，以臺灣文學館收藏劉吶鷗的麻將牌為關鍵道具，遊戲舞台從上海百樂門、天津萬國橋、黑龍江大興安嶺、北京明陵地宮到臺灣臺南州廳。在科幻背景中，使玩家進行一場益智解謎遊戲。 Feature ￭扮演穿梭不同時空的特務角色，進入3D風格的橫向解謎遊戲。 ￭以國立臺灣文學館數位典藏進行發想，公開向大眾徵選遊戲腳本，利用歷史事件與特色建築架構冒險舞台 ￭支援Windows
row.short_description: 本遊戲以日治時期的小說家、影人劉吶鷗生平為故事文本，以臺灣文學館收藏劉吶鷗的麻將牌為關鍵道具，遊戲舞台從上海百樂門、天津萬國橋、黑龍江大興安嶺、北京明陵地宮到臺灣臺南州廳。在科幻背景中，使玩家進行一場益智解謎遊戲。

row.name: Blasting Courier
row.detailed_description: You take the role of a medieval courier tasked with the quest of delivering important letters to kings and queens (they usually reside in castles). However, your path is not easy. You have to avoid deadly mines that can blast you to the stars and back. In Blasting Courier you control a 2D top-down character. You can control that character with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. The primary goal is to reach the unique castle per level. You can also flag the mines, so you can avoid them better. Compete with friends and see who is the best medieval messenger. Levels are procedurally generated and only limited by the specs of your computer. If you have any ideas, please visit our Discord server or our subreddit! We can talk about it and probably get it into the game. Don't forget to leave a review no matter what the rating is. Constructive criticism goes a long way!
row.short_description: Find the castle as a medieval courier while avoiding the deadly mines.

row.name: Peril by MDE
row.detailed_description: Peril is a retro action adventure 2d platformer. In this game the player must battle through various worlds and defeat many enemies, all the while using a javelin as both a weapon and a tool to reach new places. Battle against dangerous enemies -Over 40 different enemies to face -7 unique and challenging bosses -Choose to slice them with your sword or snipe them with your javelin Upgrade character stats -Collect gems and coins to upgrade your sword strength, javelin power, max health, or javelin capacity Use your Javelin to jump across obstacles -Master the art of throwing your javelin to make a new platform Solve puzzles -Puzzles are built to be solves in many unique ways. The javelin can provide some creative solutions to challenges.
row.short_description: Use your javelin to jump across platforms, solve puzzles, and defeat monsters in seven unique worlds. If you are a fan of retro platformers, you are going to love this game!

row.name: Flash Party
row.detailed_description: JOIN US ON DISOCRD About the Game Enjoy the Thrill of Battle! Flash Party is back with the Dark Side of the Moon major update: a whole new batch of colorful stickers, weekly free heroes, community event trophy walls...the exciting and fun-filled battle party continues! Flash Party is a platform fighter. You can control the most interesting heroes in this exciting fighting party. Attack, jump, dodge, and block... throw your opponents off-stage with all sorts of moves! Discover your unique style, and you are the next Party Star! [How to Win] To win the party, it's as simple as knocking everyone else off-stage! Attack the Heroes controlled by other players and increase the Knock-out Score above their head; The higher the KO Score, the more susceptible they are to knock-outs. [Original Characters] Meet all kinds of unique original characters! A Chubby snowman, a God of Trial that descends from heaven, a high school girl with an apple-shaped head, and an idol singer admired by all, everyone’s waiting for you in the exciting Flash Party battles! Of course, there's also the brand new hero from the indie action game ICEY, as well as the Kamaitachi Girl designed by players... With over 20 unique heroes to choose from and more new heroes being introduced, the action never stops! The Heroes are categorized into four types: All-rounder, Assaulter, Power House, and Impeder; each has an exclusive fighting mechanism. All-rounder: Attack in three directions to accumulate energy and release a Super Neutral Special Assaulter: Cancel specific attacks with certain moves to remove the Ending Lag, creating abundant combo openings and variations Power House: The higher their KO Score is, the more powerful their Attack becomes Impeder: Attack Shields to accumulate energy and release a Super Grab & Throw [Easy Start] After the Dark Side of the Moon major update , two heroes will be available for free trial every week, which can be used without restrictions in all modes! We hope that new coming players can also try various heroes until you find your own favorite hero! The new Wish Come True Card event also allows you to obtain the desired colorful stickers more easily, and the first-time activation is completely free! [Game Modes] Here, you will participate in 1v1 Challenge, Team Competition, Brawl, and Soccer Showdown, as well as weekend-limited event modes, and Friendly Battle mode to play with friends anytime. For players who want to hone their skills, join the Pinnacle Arena! Rise to higher ranks in modes such as Pinnacle Solo, Pinnacle Relay, and Pinnacle Team, and become a master player in the party! [Become the Champion] Thanks to the support of the global community, we are able to continue hosting exciting and dynamic competitions in Flash Party! In the Dark Side of the Moon major update, we have added the Trophy Wall feature. Winning official tournaments and community-certified events will earn you commemorative trophies in your personal profile! [Costumes] Collect various themed hero skins, KO effects, and other decorations from themes like Pool Party, Oriental Legend, Western Adventure, and Cosmic Adventure to become the shining star of the party! [Season: Party Pass] Each season has a unique party pass theme, and by participating in competitions or completing seasonal missions, you can unlock party rewards, including skins, emojis, KO effects, and more. Purchase a Star Card to unlock more missions and have a chance to redeem past season-exclusive rewards. [To Be a Party Animal] Find more friends in the party, team up for battle or practice together. Create a dojo and improve together with friends. Edit your hero banner to showcase your accumulated achievements. Compete for the regional rankings of hero scores and arena ranks and become a top-ranked fighter in your area. Go to the video hall to find your mentor. Here, you have multiple ways to enjoy the joyful fighting party with others! Party stars, show us what you've got!
row.short_description: Flash Party brings another major update: new colorful stickers, weekly free heroes, community event trophy wall... The fun and exciting fighting party continues! Flash Party is a platform fighter. Attack, jump, dodge, and block... throw your opponents off-stage with all sorts of moves!

row.name: Smelogs Playground
row.detailed_description: JOIN OUR DISCORD About the Game Conquer the Aztec Realm! Smelogs Playground invites you to enter the mystical realm of ancient Aztec civilization. Build your base, command armies, and wield powerful magical spells. Whether you’re a seasoned strategist or a newcomer to the genre, Smelogs Playground offers an immersive experience that combines strategy, combat, and enchantment. Base Building Construct your Aztec stronghold from the ground up. Gather resources, construct Cave systems, and fortify walls. Will you create an impenetrable fortress or an elaborate maze of traps? Your base is the heart of your empire, and its design will impact your success on the battlefield. Dynamic Sidegrade In the mystical Aztec world of Smelogs Playground, nothing is static. Units possess hidden potential—they can evolve into structures, and buildings can morph back into warriors. Unit Controlling and Combat Lead your units to victory. From swift Ballers to punchy warriors to the powerful Obsidian Cannons, assemble your forces strategically. Micromanage troops during epic battles to outmaneuver foes. Witness the clash of armies as they vie for dominance. Crystal Codex Spells Tap into the mystical energy of the Crystal Codex. Learn powerful spells that can turn the tide of battles. Summon comet showers, heal wounded soldiers and structures, or uncover hidden enemies. Base Editor Define how your initial base should look like before the match has even started. You can place units and buildings for strategic depth right from the start of the match. Unleash your creativity! Design custom bases, and share them with friends. Procedural generated maps with Neutral Objectives Navigate, adapt, and overcome the unknown capture neutral objectives and beware of unknown creatures. Player Progression and Customization Advance through levels and unlock new challenges and cosmetics. Personalize your appearance, avatar, border, and title. Stand out on the battlefield and let your enemies know who they’re up against. Online Ranked Ladder Battles Challenge the Best: Test your mettle against players from around the world. Climb the ranked ladder by winning battles. Rise through the tiers—from novice to grand master. Elo Points: Each victory earns you Elo points, while defeats deduct them. Prove your strategic prowess and ascend to the top ranks. Custom Game Lobbies Host Your Arena: Create custom lobbies with personalized rules. Choose map settings, and even tweak resource rates. Invite friends or fellow strategists to join your private matches. Variety Unleashed: Whether it’s a no-rush skirmish or a resource-rich clash, tailor the game to your liking. Experiment with unconventional strategies and settings. Skirmish Against AI Training Grounds: Hone your skills. Face off against cunning AI opponents. Adjust difficulty levels—from novice to deity—and learn the intricacies of unit management and base building. Experiment and Learn: Try out new tactics, explore the tech tree, and discover hidden synergies. The AI adapts, so stay on your toes! Single-player and Coop Tackle dynamic missions, manage your loadout, and complete objectives while strategically navigating the Playground, balancing risk to secure successful extractions and progress further. The Aztec realm awaits your command. Will you forge alliances, dominate the ranked ladder, or unravel the mysteries of Smelogs Playground?
row.short_description: Smelogs Playground is a Free-to-Play Real-Time Strategy game with charming aesthetics and a simple but effective gameplay mechanism. Take over the playful and rocky Smelogs to compete against each other for fun and honor!

row.name: Red Colony 3 Uncensored
row.detailed_description: The Red Colony series doesn’t take itself too seriously. The first game is set on a communist version of Mars, the second is based on a Jurassic Park gone even more wrong than the movie - and the third, well you’ll have to play to find out. Story It’s here, the final chapter in a series that has taken you across the solar system and had you battle it out against zombies, perverts, dinosaurs and now even ROBOTS! Red Colony 3 Uncensored picks up directly after the events in Red Colony 2 Uncensored. You play as Mina, a sexy big bosomed android, who is returning to her home planet of Titan with the precious dinosaur DNA, desired by her Queen. Her mission complete, Mina looks forward to her long awaited reward- to be ‘Turned’. Finally after years of servitude, she will gain her own free will, live the life she wants and at last learn what it means to love. However, her dreams come to a screeching halt when a stowaway aboard her ship causes an uprising on Titan, which Mina is blamed for. Not only that - dinosaurs were not the only thing Mina brought back with her from Mars. . . Help Mina fight zombies, dinosaurs and mutagenic monsters in the classic Red Colony, edge of your seat fashion. Scour the environment for clues to unlock tricky puzzles and follow the twisting, whacky story to its climatic conclusion when Red Colony 3 Uncensored launches very soon on Steam! Features - Fantastic anime character design. - A twisted, gruesome and unfair story. - Good-old-fashioned bloody, gory horror! - Patent-pending ;) 2DTCT (2D Tear-Clothes-Technology). - A Graphic Novel style narrative with classic Survival Horror gameplay. - Multiple sexy outfits for Mina. - Nudity and steamy content not allowed on other gaming platforms. FAQ Can I use keyboard and mouse to play the game? Yes- you can use the keyboard to move around and interact within the game. However, the game is designed for a gamepad and we suggest you play it with one. What are the differences between this version and the Switch version? Steam Achievements Nudity/ Nude Mode and Uncensored content Better lighting and particle effects How many endings are there? There are two endings to Red Colony 3 Uncensored. What is the ‘Uncensored’ content? That the player can play in Nude Mode as Mina and can see the NPC characters’ breasts. Do I have to play the Red Colony games in order? Not really. They work in any order.
row.short_description: You play as Mina, a sexy, big bosomed android, who is returning to Titan with precious dino DNA, desired by her Queen. Her mission complete, Mina looks forward to her reward - to be ‘Turned’. However, her dreams come to a halt when a stowaway causes an uprising on Titan, which Mina is blamed for.
row.notes: Nipples and lightly dressed women.

row.name: Bullet Bash
row.detailed_description: Blast through a series of FPS based minigames with your friends and prove your greatness! Whether you're an ultra experienced FPS expert or a more casual player, Bullet Bash has minigames for all types. From the sane and sensible to sheer comedic insanity, from classic minigames to the brand new, there will be plenty of fun (and agonizing pain) for all. Minimum of four players recommended but, can be played with as many as twelve. Here are just some of the minigames available: Rocket Jump Race- Prove you're the ultimate rocket jump master or the ultimate boomer who knows... Dodgeball- Similar to the sport but with more explosives, way more explosives... One Gun- Everyone starts with the same gun prove you're the best sniper/assault/shotgun etc... specialist there is One Shot Kill- Similar to One Gun but all weapons (and explosives) kill instantly. You've gotta stay on your toes and watch out because danger could come at anytime. Blindfold- Players receive a blindfold on spawn. Every so often the blindfold gets removed but only briefly. Knockout- Knock opponents out of the arena with some serious firepower. Breakfloor- Break the floor... and hope your opponent doesn't do the same... Trap Master- Reimagining of a famous game mode. In Trap Master you must either activate traps eliminating enemy players or survive said traps and return the favor. and more!
row.short_description: Minigames meet FPS madness in this epic party game. Play with your friends, your enemies and your friends recently turned enemies.

row.name: Transformation Tycoon
row.detailed_description: [18+] Transformation Tycoon is a transformation themed, tycoon-style business simulation game. You have just unlocked a patented new technique to transform people into other sexes, animals, items, mythological beings, and more. What do you plan to do with this new knowledge? Make money, of course! You have rented a small clinic on a city street where visitors can be transformed into the body of their dreams--for a price, of course! In this business simulation / tycoon-style game, you research new types of transformations to satisfy a growing pool of eager applicants. Hire employees to help you out and incentivize them with their own illustrated transformations. Take out loans to help you grow and begin advertisement campaigns to spread the word of your services. Upgrade your transformation chambers and move to larger, more prestigious locations. Grow your fame to attract applicants from local legends, Hollywood stars, and all manners of international celebrities each with their own reason for being transformed, or having others in their inner circle be transformed. Do all this to change the world one transformation at a time and become the ultimate TRANSFORMATION TYCOON ! IMPLEMENTED FEATURES: - Hire and manage employees from a unique cast of illustrated characters and perform transformation on them as their skills progress. Happy employees are efficient employees, and nothing makes them happier than giving them the body of their dreams! - Research new transformation types via paying research test subjects. - Hundreds of generated/randomized clients featuring thirteen transformation types: Feminization, Defeminization, Masculinization, Demasculinization, Feralization, Inanimation, Shrinking, Growth, Corruption, Purification, Personality, Fantasticalization, and Merging. - Story clients: repeat customers with storylines that progress alongside your clinic. - Alternate transformation choices: The transformation a client is expecting doesn't always have to be the one you're giving them! - Maintain your inventory of transformation crystals. Don't fall short of a crystal type when you need it most! - Configurable automatic inventory restocking, so long as you can afford it. - Advertise your clinic to increase application rate. - Handle Random Events that may help or hurt your finances, fame, infamy, employee morale, and more. - Employee client delegation can be enabled to auto-process already seen generated clients to help you see new characters more easily. - Relocate your clinic to attract more prestigious clients from local businessmen and women to Hollywood actors and actresses to international celebrities - Construct additional transformation chambers to process more clients at once, as well as upgrading existing ones to perform transforms more quickly and with a better chance at good results. - Take out and repay loans for temporary cash increase, but be wary of interest and daily payments! - Transformation calibration slider minigame to create skill-based transformation results for perfectionist players. The minigame can also be skipped by enabling on Autocalibration. - Rise the twelve tycoon ranks: Transformer-In-Training, Beginner Matter Mutator, Amateur Body-Morpher, Apprentice Alterator, Initiate Reengineer, Professional Remaker,Esteemed Recombinator, Metamorphosis Master, Renowned Reconstitutor, Regeneration Magnate, Titan of Transfiguration, and Transformation Tycoon! - Comes with a built-in Client Writer, allowing you to create your own generated and story clients that can be added to your game or shared with friends. We already have a number of community-written clients in the game and are always welcome to officially incorporating more! See Early Access for more information on what we still plan on adding to the game. NOTE : This game is centered around transformation themes including gender-bending (male to female, female to male, or inbetween), transformation into animals and anthropomorphic beings (anthros, furries), inanimate transformations (statues, clothing, adult toys), merging / absorption / transformation into body parts, shrinking, growth, and more. Undesired transformation themed can be disabled by simply not researching those transformation types , though game balance and content level is affected. Transformation lengths vary between a few days to being permanent, depending on the client. Be aware there are text-based descriptions of nudity and adult acts .
row.short_description: [18+] Run a small clinic that performs transformations for clients. Research new transformation techniques. Hire staff and fulfill their dreams by granting them their own transformation. Upgrade your clinic and gain fame (or infamy!) from your actions. Become the ultimate TRANSFORMATION TYCOON!

row.name: Kolhii ChampionsAU
row.detailed_description: (Champions AU is a fan project, and not endoresed by The Lego Group) On the great island of Mata Nui, the matoran compete for honor and glory in the great sport of Kolhii! With the copper masks up for grabs, all bets are off in this highly competitive arena! Exploit every weakness your opponent shows, build up your own strengths, every mistake is punished. Meet new and familiar faces as you explore the island, and compete to become renowned in every village! There is no time for fun and games. This is where champions are made! Kolhii Champions is an online sports arena game, where players can compete in minigames and sports events inspired by the original BIONICLE series from The Lego Group! Players can customize their matoran using set and color accurate pieces, including pieces that were never printed in certain colors! Our namesake, the sport of Koli, is a game where a number of players up to 4 enter a field and each have their own goal to protect. Players kick stone comets into eachothers goals to score points and remove points from others! Strategy and threat assessment is required to come out on top! With graphics inspired by classic content such as the Mata Nui Online Games, or the Piraka Animations; mixed with modern visual fidelity, our aesthetic is one of revamped nostalgia. In this world first online BIONICLE experience, we aim to bring in not only old fans, but newer ones as well! We aim to craft an experience and community that joins everyone together, and further the legacy that the original series has created!
row.short_description: On the great island of Mata Nui, the matoran compete for honor and glory in the great sport of Kolhii! With the copper masks up for grabs, all bets are off in this highly competetive arena. This is where champions are made!

row.name: Unreal Mashup
row.detailed_description: I am attempting to create a shooter experience tailored to our community's wishes. So what you see is what we all are looking for. Fast dynamic lateral movement and ideal projectile randomness incorporated with stylized animations which are generated dynamically via Unreal Engine's animation montage system, which by the way, is eye candy. We are using the Lyra shooter project as our base and as we go. I am planning to create customizable guns and characters along with providing stat based ranking and comparative match making. This will be the first game Ive created by myself so be aware Ill do my best to make this something good. This project was created for our community to have fun in a semi private way. As well this is a test of the unreal engines main shooter template LYRA which I'll be modifying as we go so updates will be a thing however I also know this thing is buggy! lol There are some audio glitching happening during respawns. Might just wanna turn that music volume down till I can get a fix for that. Now this is a basic third person shooter with a litany of baked in and ready to utilize features that over time I am going to learn and hopefully be able to modify and implement. I also want to point out that the networking system is janky ATM so we use Epic to run the game server hosting experience. All and all The game, so far, is functional and very small at a whopping 1.8 gigs So technically almost anyone can play it! Im hoping to have cross platform and VR worked out at some point in the future and honestly it could be working already however I have not been able to test it in that format yet. There are currently 10 maps included. Demon Station, Big Star Station, Convolution, Expanse, Space station, Soul Slum Forest, Soul Slum, Soul Cave, Shooter Gym and Overworld. There are currently 7 guns included. They are: Pistol, Shotgun, Rifle, Auto Sniper, Grenade, Grenade launcher, Rocket launcher. Health pickups are a thing as well. I hope you enjoy the project and Thanks in advance for any form of feedback going forward.
row.short_description: Unreal Mashup will test your gaming ability with a solid first person shooter base experience. Fight against bots or join your friends in their personal server automatically created at every login. This high pace futuristic shooter is Fast!

Easy and secure in game player match hosting, region selection for Australia and USA, game includes a READERS MANUAL FOR KEYBOARD AND MOUSE i. Happy hour in shooter games is usually 8pm.

row.name: Wonky Wizard
row.detailed_description: A very WONKY Indie adventure game, where you play a WIZARD that runs around casting spells; traveling across the landscape. This game is played in a top-down/ 3rd person RPG format, with mouse aiming, 'click-shoot' style gameplay. There are currently 2, 6 level worlds, with many more to come in the future! Following a WIZARD with bad luck regarding mushrooms. You'll Wander 'Wonky Woods,' and get your revenge on those evil mushrooms! But watch out, the forest holds more than some little mushys... There are potions, giant mushrooms, mushroom wizards, and much more! One year in-dev Indie game, Enjoy this tiny piece of my brain!
row.short_description: In this relaxed indie adventure game, you play a wizard that can shoot 'mouse-pointer' spells at little mushroom enemies, and whatever else lurks in the forrests... Explore the map, and enjoy the 3D, level based gameplay!

row.name: Medusa's Heart of Stone Chapter 01
row.detailed_description: Medusa was transformed into a gorgon for defiling Athena's temple while serving as a priestess there. Condemned to spend the rest of her life on a distant isle, she is determined to find a soulmate even though most of her visitors wish to chop off her head! Follow Medusa as she embarks on a journey to prove that even a gorgon can be loved. Play through a storyline that is both deep and lighthearted. Your actions will determine your fate. Defy mortals and the gods! Use your gorgon powers to turn things into stone. Go on quests. Meet the gods and other strange and interesting characters from greek mythology. Talk to your hair. NOTE: Originally, we planned to make this game three chapters long. Due to changing circumstances, we have decided to release the first chapter as a stand alone game. We hope you enjoy what we were able to finish.
row.short_description: Medusa's Heart of Stone is a 2D narrative driven game with action sequences, puzzles and quest interspersed throughout. Feared by mortals and forsaken by the gods, Medusa embarks on a journey to find someone who could love her.

row.name: Helix
row.detailed_description: Helix is a low-poly multiplayer FPS Hero-Shooter with MOBA-like Mechanics. During gameplay you will play as (currently) one of three characters: Aca, the red sound character specialized in close combat audio-visual attacks, Radon, the green smell character specialized in fast-moving prey-stalking combat through his heightened sense of smell, and Vision, the blue sight character specialized in long-range sniping combat, enhanced thanks to his improved owl-like sight. During a match, you will have to kill your opponents and steal their DNA to unlock and upgrade your abilities which will give you an edge against anyone standing in your way. There are (currently) two main modes, deathmatch, where through the use of your abilities you will have to kill the most amount of players, or team-deathmatch, which starts off as a normal team fight, but later evolves into a king-of-the-hill, where players with the most abilities will be able to unlock an area to capture. Through the unlock and upgrade of skills during the match and a dynamic game mode. Helix is trying to pursue a mix of FPS with MOBA-like mechanics.
row.short_description: Helix is a low-poly multiplayer FPS Hero-Shooter with MOBA-like Mechanics where during a match you will have to kill your opponents and steal their DNA to unlock and upgrade your abilities, giving you an edge against anyone standing in your way.

row.name: The Shattered Elements Arena
row.detailed_description: - Top down view, controller based 2D physics action - Engaging maneuvering using both joysticks - Four elements and a dozen unique incarnations to play with, both human and animal - Up to four player local co-op or remote play using Steam - Random, procedurally generated indie art environment with original music - Enhance your mage throughout your journey by picking up items - Four zones to traverse with different enemies and bosses
row.short_description: A controller based, top-down, 2D physics action game for 1-4 players. Maneuver your squad of mages through four zones of dangerous encounters with the Jurisdiction in an Arena which was devised by the Wise Witch in order to train the Defiance.

row.name: Cemetery Mary
row.detailed_description: Cemetery Mary is the story about a girl who loves visiting the cemetery. When rumors of a serial killer start floating around town, she isn't too worried--that is, until her parents go missing. And in the wake of their disappearance, a message from an unknown number leaves Mary to wade through a sea of doubts and questions. Unknown Number Your parents are safe. [12:43 AM] Is the rumored 'Blackwood Butcher' playing some sort of sick prank? Or is something even more sinister responsible for their disappearance? Will she be able to find the identity of the mysterious killer, or the whereabouts of her parents? Or will her meddling threaten to make her a permanent resident of the very cemetery she so admires? This visual novel consists of 3 different routes, each with a Good Ending and a Bad Ending. There is also a True Ending, which can potentially be unlocked by playing any of the 3 routes. Average playtime for 1 route is 2-2.5 hours. The True Ending is capable of adding an additional 1-2 hours. Credits follow the True Ending!
row.short_description: A visual novel about a girl who loves the cemetery. When her parents go missing, she receives a mysterious text that has the potential to completely ruin her life...or fix it?

row.short_description: No one knows victory better than me! I come, I see, I conquer! Idle casual war game, brand new gameplay, use swords and magic to conquer the unknown continent!

row.name: HIGHBLAST
row.detailed_description: Highblast is now in its 3rd version. Hope you enjoy and thanks for playing if you have! We really appreciate it. Story Context HIGHBLAST is set on a planet in a distant solar system. You work for the local star system defence force. They prevent any 1 group of people from completely controlling a planet. You are helping to free a planet from an evil civilisation who want to take all the resources for war against other planets. You must infiltrate enemy bases to perform reconnaissance and weaken the enemy. Basic Game Mechanics (Not yet complete and coming soon) Enhance your robot soldiers by equipping various arm mounted or arm replacing weapons. Examples include a anti-drone radar, a flamethrower and a rail-gun! If a robot is disabled do not worry, you have backups! You will be able to upgrade the number of robots you can deploy in later game versions. Once all enemies are destroyed you return to the ship and leave for orbit to do repairs and upgrades. Custom Maps (Unavailable) You have the freedom to create your own maps and share them with others on the Steam Workshop with Highblast's Level Foundry . The map pieces snap to a grid. And new pieces and fixes are being worked on all the time! We are also considering procedural maps for infinite replayability! Early Development Disclaimer Highblast was originally released as a first game and was very very.... Indie in it's lack of everything. But we liked the concept an wanted to make something similar with a lot more content and a cool story. So if it seems far from finished, it is. And we (2 to 3 people in our free time) are constantly working on new stuff and fixes for old stuff. WE WILL NOT NEGLECT THIS GAME UNTIL IT'S DONE! :) Please enjoy and watch Highblast grow!
row.short_description: You have a spaceship ship full of robots, a drone and a planet to sabotage for the safety of the solar system. Highblast is a game about an agency protecting a solar system from a greedy civilisation.

row.name: WOLF RIOT
row.detailed_description: Frank is having a bad night, he's a Werewolf just trying to get by. He's cornered in a convenience store by a platoon of Hunters, a secretive Mercenary group hell bent on exterminating the Lycan kind. They've been tracking Frank for weeks and now they have him right where they want him, silver bullets in the chamber, but he's not dead yet. A short, blood soaked beat'em'up. Survive the night, featuring the music of DEgITx. FEATURES: -Progressive destruction: Tear through enemies and helpless inanimate produce as the store gets more and more messed up over the course of your battle. -A ludicrous amount of physics objects and particle effects, nearly every item in the store can be displaced. -Move quickly throughout the store, dodging enemy fire and ambushing your attackers. -Quickly chain attacks together for ultimate carnage, score 50 kills to survive the night.
row.short_description: Survive the night. Play as Frank the Werewolf for a wave based cage fight for survival. Tear through a convenience store to fend off a mechanized infantry platoon of mercenaries.
row.notes: Heavy use of blood effects.
